title: Creative Strategist — Ecommerce
description:
About the company

We run a portfolio of accessory and jewelry e-commerce brands selling to Western markets (primarily Europe and North America). Our model is dropshipping-based — we source products, build brands around them, and scale them through paid social. We do 7 figures per year and are growing fast.

We're building a serious creative production operation and need someone who understands performance marketing, not just aesthetics.



The role

You will own the creative strategy for our video content. That means identifying winning angles, writing scripts and briefs, managing a small team of freelance videographers and editors, and making sure we ship 80–100 short-form video creatives per month consistently.

You will work directly with the founder. He sets the strategic direction and identifies angles to explore — you translate that into production-ready briefs and manage delivery end to end.



What you'll do

Spy on competitor ads (Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center, Minea or AdSpy) and reverse-engineer winning angles

Define creative concepts and write clear scripts/briefs for each video format (UGC, b-roll, product close-up, testimonial, etc.)

Hit a consistent output of 80–100 video creatives per month across different formats and lengths

Stay current on AI-generated ad formats that are performing right now — you know what's working on Meta with AI creative and can brief accordingly

Track hook rate, hold rate, and CPA per creative — flag what's working, kill what's not

Report weekly to the founder: what went out, what's performing, what to scale or cut



What we're looking for



Non-negotiable:

title: Creative Strategist & Content Producer
description:
About the company

At Miraco Nutripharm, we are dedicated to advancing health & improving lives. Our goal is to relieve 1 billion people worldwide of pain & discomfort. If you know of anyone who has been worried about or suffered from any health problems, join us in making a positive impact by reducing the pain & distress others have to endure.

Job description

We're looking for a Creative Strategist & Content Producer to shape how our health & pharmaceutical brands communicate across both digital & offline channels. You'll craft effective strategies that translate scientific credibility into compelling storytelling & creative assets - helping us engage our diverse audience as we expand our presence regionally. 



The Creative Strategist & Content Producer will be the visionary link between our brand identity, compelling content creation & drive measurable performance across all key channels. This role is responsible for developing & testing high-impact creative strategies as well as producing content assets (visual, video, copy) internally, specifically designed to drive traffic, increase conversion rates, lower Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) & drive overall revenue growth for our Shopify, Shopee & Lazada stores via social media as well as paid advertising platforms.



You'll work across multiple channels & markets to plan, create & optimize content that builds awareness, strengthens partnerships & supports the new channels of the business. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing creativity, analytics & brand strategy in the health supplement industry. 



Key Responsibilities:

Creative Strategy

- Platform & Channel Strategy: Craft tailored creative strategies for B2C & B2B audiences optimized for platform-specific best practices & formats that align with brand goals & regulatory requirements in each market (e.g., Meta carousel ads, vertical video for TikTok/Reels, static product carousels for Shopee/Lazada e-commerce banner ads).

- Hypothesis Generation & A/B Testing: Develop robust creative testing matrices, formulate clear hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, calls-to-action, visual styles, copy length) that drive measurable improvements in Click-Through Rate (CTR) & Conversion Rate (CVR).

- Audience Segmentation: Translate target audience data & segmentation provided by media buyers into resonant creative themes, ensuring content speaks directly to different stages of the marketing funnel (awareness, consideration, conversion).

- Competitive Analysis: Continuously keep up to date with competitors & industry trends, identifying new & successful creative formats, hooks & messaging to finetune our strategy.

In-House Content Production & Execution 

- Performance Creative Development: Lead the end-to-end creative concept development & production for all organic & paid media campaigns (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube, etc.) that align with brand & campaign goals, focusing on high-volume, quick-turnaround testing required for performance marketing.

- Hands-on Asset Creation: Directly produce & edit native social content & performance ads using existing assets, stock libraries & internal resources. This includes:

i. Plan platform-specific content calendars: Cover educational, promotional & corporate communications

ii. Static/Image Editing: Adapt product photography, create ad variations & design simple graphics & banner ads

iii. Video Editing: Fast-paced assembly, cutting, adding text overlays, music & effects for short-form, vertical video (UGC-style, product demos, testimonials)

- Copywriting: Develop high-converting ad copy, landing page headlines & social media captions that align with the creative strategy & brand voice, with a focus on clear value propositions & strong CTAs.

- Asset Management: Ensure all campaign assets are correctly tagged, archived & deployed across relevant channels (Shopify, Shopee, Lazada store fronts & advertising platforms).

- Testing & Optimization: apply insights & analytics to refine & optimize content effectiveness across platforms.

Performance & Reporting

- Data-Driven Insights: Work closely with the Marketing Manager to analyze creative performance reports, identifying which creative variables are driving results (or failing) across Shopify, Shopee & Lazada traffic.

- Iteration & Optimization: 

i. Develop, adapt or review content & formats to improve engagement & performance

ii. Use performance data (ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR) to rapidly iterate on existing creative assets & inform future strategy, ensuring a continuous cycle of improvement & optimization

Storefront Integration: Integrate winning creative messages & visuals onto the respective e-commerce storefronts (product pages, banners) to ensure a cohesive customer journey.

Multi-Channel Storytelling

- Content cohesion: Ensure content is aligned where possible across digital & print media, including LinkedIn, Instagram,
, YouTube, e-commerce platforms, brochures & trade materials.

- Tailor content: To achieve relevance & effectiveness across different stages of the audience journey — from brand awareness & education to conversion.

- Storytelling & visual consistency: To strengthen brand trust & recognition.

Compliance & Brand Integrity

- Uphold regulatory & ethical communication standards across all marketing activities.

- Ensure all content complies with regulatory guidelines & marketing requirements in each country we operate in, including product claims, advertising language & digital promotions.

- Maintain brand credibility by ensuring all communications are factual & aligned with company values.

- Collaborate with internal teams to review materials for accuracy, effectiveness & compliance before publication.



Requirements:

- 3–5 years of experience in creative strategy, content creation, social media, or brand marketing — ideally in health supplements, healthcare or wellness.

- Strong understanding of social media trends & platform best practices (Meta (FB/IG), LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Google, Generative AI).

- Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere Pro), CapCut, Canva, Figma, or similar tools.

- Excellent writing, editing & visual storytelling skills — adopt a strategic approach to design that integrates marketing & commercial goals.

- Excellent communication, project management & cross-functional collaboration skills.

- Familiarity with regulatory communication standards or track record in health supplements or healthcare industry is a plus.

title: Senior Automation & Web Developer — Zapier / Airtable / APIs / WordPress / GTM / AI
description:
About Us



We're a fast-growing Australian business finance company. We're a lean team that competes through automation — our tech stack does the work of 100 people, and we're hiring one senior person to own, extend, and improve it full-time. (Company details shared with shortlisted candidates at interview stage.)



This is NOT a VA role and NOT a junior dev role. You'll be the technical builder for the business, working directly with the owner (who built the current systems and knows them deeply — you won't be guessing alone).



Our Stack (you'll work across most of this)



-Zapier (advanced: code steps, webhooks, paths, error handling — not just simple Zaps)

-Airtable (automations, scripting, complex base design, API)

-Pipedrive CRM (API, webhooks, workflow automation)

-ActiveCampaign (automations, API)

-Python (Flask services deployed on Google Cloud Run)

-REST APIs generally — reading API docs and building reliable integrations is the core of this job

-LLM integrations (Claude / OpenAI APIs — building automations that use AI models via API)

-WordPress — custom code (PHP/HTML/CSS/JS), performance optimisation (Core Web Vitals), and ongoing site management. Not just themes and plugins — you must be able to work in the code.

-Google Tag Manager & tracking — GTM container setup, dataLayer coding, UTM parameter architecture, conversion tracking (including server-side / Conversions API)

-Cloudflare, DNS, domains & hosting — DNS records, security settings, SSL, domain management (GoDaddy etc.), hosting environments

-Softr (client portal on top of Airtable)

-Plus: SMS APIs (Twilio/Sinch), Meta Conversions API, and AI voice APIs



You don't need experience with every tool — but you MUST be strong on Zapier + Airtable + APIs + Python + WordPress (real coding, not just plugins), and able to learn the rest fast from documentation.



What You'll Do



-Build new automations and improve existing ones (lead routing, CRM workflows, client notifications, and LLM-powered automation systems)

-Own our WordPress website end-to-end: performance (Core Web Vitals), custom code changes, design polish, and reliability

-Own our tracking infrastructure: GTM, dataLayer, UTM architecture, and conversion tracking accuracy across Meta and Google

-Manage the infrastructure layer: Cloudflare, DNS, domains, hosting, SSL, and security settings

-Innovate with AI. We use LLMs heavily across our systems and expect you to stay current with new models, tools, and techniques — and to proactively propose where AI can improve or replace existing processes. "I saw this new capability and built a prototype" is the energy we pay bonuses for.

-Debug production issues by finding root causes — not patching symptoms

-Integrate third-party APIs by reading official documentation carefully and verifying exact parameter specs (this is a hard requirement for us — guessing at API parameters is how systems break)

-Write clear documentation: every automation you ship comes with a written spec and runbook. No exceptions.

-Proactively identify problems and improvements before being asked — we pay bonuses specifically for this



Compensation



-Base: USD $2,500–3,000/month depending on experience

-Monthly performance bonus: USD $300–800 based on shipped systems that run reliably, documentation quality, and -proactive problem-finding. Opportunity to go even higher, based on performance.

-Annual base increases for strong performers

-Long-term, stable, full-time role — we are building for years, not months



Hours Of Work



Full-time, Monday–Friday, working - 9am - 6pm SYDNEY TIME.



Who This Role Suits



-5+ years building automations, integrations, and websites professionally — you're a senior generalist who's comfortable owning the entire technical surface of a business, not a specialist in one tool

-You're a problem solver and have a high degree of attention to detail

-You chase root causes, not symptoms — "I found why it breaks" instead of "I added a workaround"

-You read API documentation for fun (or at least without pain)

-You're genuinely excited by AI — you already use LLMs in your own workflow, follow new releases, and have built things with -AI APIs because you wanted to, not just because a client asked

-You test your own work before calling it done

-You communicate clearly and proactively — if something is blocked or broken, we hear it from you first

-You want one stable long-term client who pays well and pays bonuses, not five gigs



Who This Role Does NOT Suit



-Anyone whose Zapier experience is limited to simple two-step Zaps

-Anyone whose WordPress experience is page builders only (Elementor/Divi) — if you can't work directly in PHP/HTML/CSS/JS and diagnose performance issues in the code, this isn't your role

-Anyone who hardcodes credentials or guesses at API parameters instead of checking docs

-Anyone juggling multiple clients (we require exclusivity during work hours)

-Agencies, teams, or anyone planning to subcontract any part of this work. We are hiring you, one individual — the person we interview is the person who does the work, always. Given the financial data our systems handle, subcontracting is treated as a serious breach and grounds for immediate termination.

-Anyone uncomfortable with logged/audited system access — we run strict security practices (scoped credentials, audit trails). Honest builders find this boring; that's the point.



Security Note (read this — it matters)



We work with financial data, so we follow least-privilege access practices: you'll use your own named accounts and scoped API keys, production credentials are managed by the owner, and system activity is logged. This is standard, professional, and protects you as much as us. If that sounds reasonable, we'll get along great.



SKILL REQUIREMENTS 



Required:



-Zapier (Expert)

-Airtable (Expert)

-AI Tool Use — Claude Code / ChatGPT (Expert)

-API Integration / REST APIs (Expert)

-WordPress — custom code & performance (Advanced)

-Google Tag Manager / UTM / conversion tracking (Advanced)

-Python (Advanced)

-HTML / CSS / JavaScript (Advanced)

-Webhooks (Advanced)

-Cloudflare / DNS / domain & hosting management (Intermediate–Advanced)



Strongly preferred:



-Pipedrive or similar CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce)

-ActiveCampaign or similar (Mailchimp, Klaviyo)

-Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions)

-Flask or similar Python web frameworks

-Meta Conversions API / server-side tracking



Nice to have:



-Softr / no-code app builders

-Twilio / Sinch / Kixie, SMS APIs

-SQL





HOW TO APPLY 



To apply, send a message that includes ALL of the following — applications missing any item will not be read:



1. Start your message with the word "PINEAPPLE" so we know you read the full post.



2. Your 2–3 best automation/integration projects — for each: what it did, which tools/APIs were involved, and one problem you hit and how you solved it. Specific detail matters more than polish. Include links wherever possible — live websites you've built or optimised, GitHub, portfolio, or Loom walkthroughs. Claims we can verify are worth far more than claims we can't.



3. Answer this question: A Zapier webhook step is receiving data from a third-party API, but one field arrives blank for about 4% of records even though the source system shows the data exists. Describe, step by step, how you would diagnose this. (There is no single right answer — we're looking at how you think.)



4. Answer this question: A WordPress landing page scores poorly on Core Web Vitals (high CLS, slow LCP) and its Meta conversion tracking is undercounting leads. Briefly: what are the first things you'd check for each problem?



5. Your expected monthly salary in USD.



6. Confirm you can work 9:00am–6:00pm Sydney time (including the earlier Manila start during Australian daylight saving) full-time and exclusively.



7. A short video introduction (3–5 minutes, camera on) — Loom or similar. Briefly: who you are, what you've built that you're proudest of, and what specifically about this role appeals to you. No script needed, no editing, no polish — we just want to meet the actual person we'd be talking to every morning.



If you're selected, we'll contact you back to arrange a quick interview to see if we're a good fit to work together.

- PHP 80,000–120,000/month, commensurate with experience. Plus two bonuses each year— mid-year and year-end.

- 100% remote, forever. Work from Davao, Cebu, Baguio, the beach, the mountains —wherever you do your best work.

- No staffing tetris. You're dedicated full-time to ONE US client. No juggling five accounts, no context-switching. Real ownership, real career growth.

- 24 days of paid time off. Not to escape your job — to live your life on your terms.

- Direct mentorship from Jane Eagle (outsourced CFO, former Big 4) and real exposure to US executive teams. You'll learn at the level you want to be at, not just at the level your current role requires.

- PHP 5,000 monthly health stipend — apply it toward the HMO or insurance that fits your life.

- High bar, with us in your corner. Our client has high standards and moves fast — but you're working with us, not for them. We hire people who take pride in great work, and we make sure you have the support, structure, and advocacy to do it well.



ABOUT ME

Mom, surfer, party-lover, and teller of jokes. I help the world's biggest companies — and scrappy startups — make sense of their money as a fractional CFO (Big 4 alum, Berkeley & NYU MBA). Through Jane Eagle Consulting, I hire from a narrow pool — CPAs from top PH universities with Big 4 or large MNC experience — and place them with growing US clients. For this role, I'm the fractional CFO, so when I hire you, I'm hiring you onto a team I'm already on. If you've got high standards, want to learn from someone who's been in the seat, and still want a real life outside of work — let's talk.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a Senior Accountant for our US-based fintech client (B2B payments technology). You'll report directly to the company's Controller and own the day-to-day accounting — AR, AP, and month-end close — for a growing, well-funded company.



This is a hands-on Senior Accountant seat, not a leadership role. You'll be in the books daily and partnering closely with the Controller, Customer Success, and engineering teams. There is real growth potential as the business scales.



The client moves fast and sets a high bar — you'll be doing real, meaningful work. The benefit of working with Jane Eagle Consulting: you have us in your corner. We mentor, advocate for you, and make sure you have what you need to succeed.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Accounts Receivable & Collections

• Generate and review monthly invoices in QuickBooks Online (QBO)

• Identify and flag discrepancies; perform month-over-month variance analysis

• Verify subscription start dates for newly onboarded merchants

• Follow up with merchants on outstanding invoices and manage collections

• Partner with Customer Success on renewals validation

• Support ad hoc reporting on revenue and collections



Accounts Payable & Vendor Management

• Review incoming vendor invoices and categorize to appropriate expense accounts

• Manage approval workflows in Ramp

• Flag and escalate material invoice amounts for review



General Bookkeeping & Month-End Close

• Maintain and execute the month-end checklist (accruals, prepaids, fixed assets)

• Record and reconcile bonus accruals, commission accruals, and payroll entries

• Perform monthly bank reconciliations

• Manage fixed asset, depreciation, and amortization schedules

• Manage the company's virtual mailbox (Earth Class Mail)



WHO YOU NEED TO BE

• Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Philippines

• Bachelor's degree in Accountancy from a top Philippine university (Ateneo, UP, La Salle, UST, or equivalent)

• 4-8 years of accounting experience

• Big 4 audit experience (SGV/EY, Isla Lipana/PwC, KPMG, Deloitte) OR senior accounting experience at a large US/multinational corporation

• Hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online (QBO) — non-negotiable for this role

• Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, financial modeling)

• Solid understanding of US GAAP

• Direct experience with full-cycle month-end close, journal entries, and reconciliations

• Excellent written and spoken English

• Available during Pacific or Eastern Standard Time hours



NICE TO HAVE

• Experience with subscription/SaaS revenue, recurring billing, or partner revenue share models

• Familiarity with Ramp, Salesforce/HubSpot, or Earth Class Mail

• Comfort working with AI tools (e.g., Claude) for research and workflow automation



HOW TO APPLY

We want to get to know you — not just your resume. Send us:

1. Your updated resume (PDF preferred)

2. A short written note OR a short video — whichever you prefer — telling us about your professional background (especially your Big 4 or MNC experience and your most recent hands-on QuickBooks Online work), why you want this role specifically, and one thing most people would be surprised to learn about you



Looking forward to hearing from you.

title: Academic Legal Research and Writing Training Program  (Paid Nonprofit Learning Initiative and Academic Support)
description:
Academic Support and Learning Program



Paid Nonprofit Learning Initiative



Our church nonprofit is building a long term academic learning and program testing initiative for individuals who may later support nonprofit education, tutoring, guidance, and community based programs.



This is a paid remote learning program for applicants who enjoy studying, learning, writing, research, academic support work, and structured online learning.



This opportunity is for paid learning participants who want to grow in a school like learning environment while helping us test and develop academic programs for future nonprofit use.



Please Read Before Applying



Please read this full post carefully before applying.



We are busy church and nonprofit workers, so we are looking for applicants who can follow written instructions without asking many questions that are already answered in this post.



Please read the post more than once before applying. Do not apply if you are going to ask questions that are already answered here.



This is not a high paying opportunity. This is a paid learning and program testing initiative for people who genuinely enjoy studying, writing, research, and learning new things.



Please do not apply if:



• You do not read instructions carefully

• You cannot follow directions

• You are not qualified

• You are not familiar with Canvas or similar online learning platforms

• You are not familiar with Turnitin or originality review systems

• You are not comfortable with the honorarium budget

• You are not interested in learning or studying

• You are not willing to work in a structured academic environment

• You cannot communicate clearly and respectfully

• You cannot provide daily progress updates

• You cannot submit quality academic work

• You do not have reliable access to a computer and internet



This opportunity is best for someone who loves to study, enjoys learning new things, communicates well, writes clearly, and may later become a strong academic support person for nonprofit related programs.



Purpose of the Program



This nonprofit initiative helps us test, evaluate, and improve academic learning programs before they are used more broadly.



Participants will:



• Study assigned learning materials

• Complete structured academic modules

• Produce original written work and presentations

• Help evaluate program quality, clarity, difficulty, and structure

• Provide consistent progress updates

• Demonstrate reliability, discipline, and quality academic effort

• Work independently in a self paced online learning environment



This is a program testing and learning participant role.



Minimum Requirements



Applicants must meet the following requirements:



• Must be a college graduate

• Must have a good GPA or strong academic record

• Must provide proof of graduation

• Must provide diploma, certificate of graduation, or equivalent proof

• Must provide Transcript of Records or official school transcript

• Must have strong reading, writing, research, and study skills

• Must be very studious and able to learn independently

• Must be comfortable with self paced online learning

• Must be familiar with Canvas or similar online learning platforms

• Must be familiar with Turnitin or originality review systems

• Must be familiar with discussion boards and online course style learning

• Must know or be willing to follow APA academic writing format

• Must have regular access to a reliable PC or laptop

• Must have stable internet access

• Must be able to submit clean, organized, and quality academic work

• Must communicate consistently and provide progress updates



Who Should Apply



This opportunity is best for:



• College graduates with strong academic habits

• College degree holders with good academic records

• Straight A students or applicants with strong study discipline

• People who love to learn and study

• People who enjoy academic writing and research

• People who are organized and detail oriented

• People interested in tutoring, academic support, nonprofit work, or program testing

• People who can work independently without constant supervision

• People who are reliable, respectful, and serious about finishing what they start

• People who are available, responsive, and comfortable working online



Character and Reliability Required



Before anything else, character and reliability come first.



We carefully evaluate character during the first sessions. Many people may be intelligent or academically capable, but if we do not see reliability, respect, honesty, quality work, and strong work ethic early on, we will not be able to continue with that applicant.



We are looking for people who:



• Follow through on commitments

• Communicate respectfully

• Provide consistent progress updates

• Complete assignments they start

• Take responsibility seriously

• Stay responsive and professional

• Show honesty, discipline, and good character

• Take pride in producing clean and quality work

• Have strong study habits and academic discipline

• Learn well independently

• Care about details and accuracy



If an applicant stops responding, disappears, abandons work midway, submits careless work, or fails to communicate, the program will end for that applicant.



Our nonprofit depends on people who finish the work they start and care about the quality of what they submit.



About the Training Program



Participants will complete structured study modules and produce academic work.



The program includes:



• Research based paper

• PowerPoint presentations with speaker notes

• Organized written work based on assigned topics

• Proper citations and references

• Discussion board style learning activities when assigned

• Final capstone project



The program evaluates:



• Writing ability

• Research and analysis

• Communication

• Discipline and consistency

• Professionalism

• Integrity

• Ability to learn and follow instructions

• Quality of submitted work

• Attention to detail



This program is designed for applicants who enjoy studying and learning and want to strengthen their academic and professional skills.



Pay and Program Structure



• Honorarium ranges from PHP 4,500 for beginners to PHP 7,000 after passing the first stage per completed program

• Final honorarium may depend on the agreement, applicant qualifications, program track, work quality, and completion requirements

• Program includes 15 structured modules

• Program length is approximately 8 weeks

• Program is self paced and competency based

• Strong applicants often finish in about 7 weeks

• Payment is based on successful completion of the required program work

• Applicants must complete the full program requirements

• Poor quality, incomplete, careless, copied, or non original work will not be accepted



Each module requires:



• APA style essay

• PowerPoint presentation with speaker notes

• Proper citations and references

• Organized academic writing

• Original work

• Quality writing and clear presentation



Module 15 is the final capstone project.



Available Program Tracks



Applicants must choose one program track.



• Program A: Criminal Justice and Community Safety. Topics include justice systems, criminology, crime prevention, and community safety.

• Program B: Healthcare Administration and Community Health. Topics include healthcare systems, health policy, healthcare management, and community health programs.

• Program C: Nursing, Health Promotion, and Community Care. Topics include community health nursing, prevention strategies, patient education, and health promotion.

• Program D: United States Studies. Topics include United States history, society, culture, and civic institutions.

• Program E: Business and Administration. Topics include business writing, management, leadership, organizational behavior, marketing, business ethics, operations, and administration.

• Program F: Recreation, Tourism, and Hospitality. Topics include recreation management, tourism studies, hospitality service, event planning, customer experience, community recreation, and travel development.

• Program G: Law and Legal Studies. Topics include legal research, legal writing, case analysis, legal ethics, public policy, legal systems, and access to justice.



Academic Writing and Original Work Requirement



Academic writing in APA style is mandatory.



Applicants are expected to already be strong in:



• Writing

• Research

• Organization

• Citations

• Academic formatting

• Quality academic work



All work must be original and written by the applicant.



AI generated writing is not allowed.



AI tools may only be used for limited support, such as:



• Brainstorming

• Outlining

• Grammar review

• Study support



However:



• Copying is not allowed

• Plagiarism is not allowed

• AI generated submissions are not allowed

• Careless rewriting or copied content is not allowed

• Sources must be cited properly in APA style

• Originality checks may be used through Turnitin or similar review systems

• Work must be suitable for originality review because it is genuinely original, properly cited, and written honestly

• Applicants must submit only their own original work



We are looking for applicants who are genuinely good at academic work and can write, research, cite, organize, and present properly without depending on AI to do the work for them.



What This Can Lead To



Applicants who demonstrate strong work ethic, honesty, consistent performance, and quality work may be invited into ongoing paid work supporting our nonprofit programs.



We continue working only with people who show:



• Reliability

• Consistent communication

• Dependable work quality

• Professionalism

• Trustworthiness

• Respectful attitude

• Strong academic effort

• Careful and quality submissions



How to Apply



: 



Message also through WhatsApp if you receive no response:




Please include:



• Updated resume

• Full name and timezone

• Daily availability in hours per day

• Program choice A, B, C, D, E, F, or G

• Writing sample, 1 to 2 pages in APA style

• PowerPoint sample, 5 to 10 slides with speaker notes

• Confirmation statement below



Confirmation Statement



“I understand this is a nonprofit academic learning and program testing initiative. I understand that I must read and follow instructions carefully. I understand originality checks may be used. AI generated writing is not allowed. AI may only be used for limited assistance. I will submit only original work and include proper APA citations where required. I also understand that quality work, reliability, and consistent communication are required.”



Required documents:



• Resume or portfolio

• Proof of graduation

• School diploma, front and back

• Transcript of Records, front and back

• Proof of GPA or academic standing, if available



For nursing graduates, please also include if available:



• BSN diploma

• CHED verification of degree equivalency

• RN license copy



Qualified applicants may be invited for a phone interview.



Please read the full post carefully before asking questions already answered here.



Apply only if you are serious, studious, reliable, respectful, academically strong, familiar with Canvas and Turnitin, comfortable with the honorarium budget, and ready to complete quality academic work.

title: Nursing Academic Learning and Writing Training Program ( Paid Nonprofit Learning Initiative and Academic Support)
description:
Nursing and Clinical Documentation Improvement Awareness Track



Fresh Nursing Graduates and Registered Nurses Welcome



Our church nonprofit is developing nursing and healthcare related academic learning programs that may later support tutoring, guidance, healthcare education support, nonprofit training, and community based educational services.



We are selecting qualified Bachelor of Science in Nursing graduates, fresh nursing graduates, registered nurses, or applicants with strong nursing education backgrounds for paid remote pilot programs.



This opportunity is for people who genuinely enjoy studying nursing, healthcare, clinical documentation, academic writing, research, structured online learning, and academic support work.



This is not a high paying position. It is best for someone who wants to learn, review nursing and healthcare related materials, strengthen academic skills, test structured learning programs, and possibly grow into future nonprofit support work.



This is a good side opportunity for someone who loves learning, is very studious, can work independently, follows instructions carefully, and has regular access to a reliable computer.



Please Read Before Applying



Please read this full post carefully before applying.



We are busy church and nonprofit workers, so we are looking for applicants who can follow written instructions without asking many questions that are already answered in this post.



Please read the post more than once before applying.



Do not apply if you are going to ask questions that are already answered here.



Please do not apply if:



• You do not read instructions carefully

• You cannot follow directions

• You are not qualified

• You are not a BSN graduate or do not have strong proof of nursing education

• You are not familiar with Canvas or similar online learning platforms

• You are not familiar with Turnitin or originality review systems

• You are not comfortable with the honorarium budget

• You are not interested in studying nursing, healthcare, or clinical documentation

• You are not willing to work in a structured academic environment

• You cannot communicate clearly and respectfully

• You cannot provide daily progress updates

• You cannot submit quality nursing related academic work

• You do not have reliable access to a computer and internet



Purpose of the Initiative



This nonprofit initiative is designed to help us test, evaluate, and improve nursing and healthcare related academic learning programs before they are used more broadly.



We are also exploring future Clinical Documentation Improvement awareness and training pathways.



Clinical Documentation Improvement, also called CDI, is a growing healthcare field where nurses may perform well because of their clinical background, critical thinking ability, and understanding of patient care. With additional exposure to documentation standards, healthcare records, and medical coding concepts, nurses may later grow into valuable documentation improvement roles.



Participants will:



• Study assigned nursing and healthcare related learning materials

• Complete structured academic modules

• Produce original written work and presentations

• Help evaluate program quality, clarity, difficulty, and structure

• Provide consistent progress updates

• Demonstrate reliability, discipline, and quality academic effort

• Work independently in a self paced online learning environment

• Build awareness of clinical documentation and healthcare education topics



This is a nursing program testing and learning participant role.



Minimum Requirements



Applicants must meet the following requirements:



• Must be a Bachelor of Science in Nursing graduate

• Fresh nursing graduates may apply

• Registered Nurses are preferred but an RN license is not required

• Must have a good GPA or strong academic record

• Must provide proof of graduation

• Must provide BSN diploma, certificate of graduation, or equivalent proof

• Must provide Transcript of Records or official school transcript

• Must have strong nursing reading, writing, research, and study skills

• Must be very studious and able to learn independently

• Must be comfortable with self paced online learning

• Must be familiar with Canvas or similar online learning platforms

• Must be familiar with Turnitin or originality review systems

• Must be familiar with discussion boards and online course style learning

• Must know or be willing to follow APA academic writing format

• Must have regular access to a reliable PC or laptop

• Must have stable internet access

• Must be able to submit clean, organized, and quality nursing related academic work

• Must communicate consistently and provide progress updates



Who This Is For



This opportunity is best for:



• BSN graduates with strong academic habits

• Fresh nursing graduates

• Registered Nurses who enjoy academic work

• Nursing graduates with strong study discipline

• People who love studying nursing and healthcare topics

• People interested in Clinical Documentation Improvement awareness

• People who enjoy academic writing and healthcare research

• People who are organized and detail oriented

• People interested in tutoring, academic support, nonprofit work, or program testing

• People who can work independently without constant supervision

• People who are reliable, respectful, and serious about finishing what they start

• People who are available, responsive, and comfortable working online



Character and Reliability Required



Before anything else, character and reliability come first.



We carefully observe applicants during the first sessions. Intelligence alone is not enough. We need people who are dependable, honest, respectful, and consistent.



We are looking for people who:



• Follow through on commitments

• Communicate respectfully

• Provide daily progress updates

• Complete assignments they start

• Take responsibility seriously

• Stay responsive and professional

• Produce clean and quality work

• Have strong study habits

• Learn well independently

• Care about details and accuracy

• Show professionalism and good character



If an applicant stops responding, disappears, submits careless work, abandons assignments, or fails to communicate, participation will end.



About the Program



Participants will complete structured nursing and healthcare related academic modules and submit original academic work.



Each program includes:



• 15 structured modules

• Assigned nursing and healthcare related study topics

• APA style essays

• PowerPoint presentations with speaker notes

• Proper citations and references

• Discussion board style learning activities when assigned

• Final capstone project

• Program feedback when requested



Each module requires:



• Original academic writing

• APA style formatting

• Proper citations and references

• Organized nursing and healthcare research

• Clear presentation work

• Quality writing and attention to detail



Possible Nursing and Healthcare Related Areas



Program topics may include:



• Nursing foundations

• Patient care concepts

• Health promotion

• Community health

• Healthcare systems

• Clinical documentation

• Clinical Documentation Improvement awareness

• Basic medical coding awareness

• Healthcare communication

• Patient education

• Care coordination

• Nursing ethics

• Documentation standards

• Quality improvement

• Healthcare administration

• Public health

• Evidence based practice

• Academic nursing writing and research



Pay and Program Structure



• Honorarium ranges from PHP 4,500 for beginners to PHP 7,000 after passing the first stage per completed program

• Final honorarium may depend on the agreement, qualifications, work quality, and completion requirements

• Program length is approximately 8 weeks

• Program is self paced and competency based

• Strong applicants may finish in about 7 weeks

• Payment is based on successful completion of the required program work

• Poor quality, incomplete, copied, careless, or non original work will not be accepted



Academic Writing and Original Work Requirement



Academic writing in APA style is mandatory.



Applicants are expected to already be strong in:



• Nursing academic writing

• Healthcare research

• Organization

• Citations

• Academic formatting

• Quality academic work

• Clear written communication

• Healthcare topic analysis



All work must be original and written by the applicant.



AI generated writing is not allowed.



AI tools may only be used for limited support, such as:



• Brainstorming

• Outlining

• Grammar review

• Study support



However:



• Copying is not allowed

• Plagiarism is not allowed

• AI generated submissions are not allowed

• Careless rewriting is not allowed

• Sources must be cited properly in APA style

• Originality checks may be used through Turnitin or similar review systems

• Work must be suitable for originality review because it is genuinely original, properly cited, and written honestly

• Applicants must submit only their own original work



We are looking for applicants who are genuinely good at nursing and healthcare related academic work and can study, write, research, cite, organize, and present properly without depending on AI to do the work for them.



What This Can Lead To



Applicants who demonstrate strong work ethic, honesty, consistency, quality work, and reliable communication may be invited to support future paid nonprofit programs.



We continue working only with people who show:



• Reliability

• Consistent communication

• Dependable work quality

• Professionalism

• Trustworthiness

• Respectful attitude

• Strong academic effort

• Careful and quality submissions



How to Apply



 your application to:







Message also through WhatsApp if you receive no response:




Please include:



• Updated resume

• Full name and timezone

• Daily availability in hours per day

• Nursing education background

• Strongest nursing or healthcare subjects

• Interest in Clinical Documentation Improvement, if any

• Writing sample, 1 to 2 pages in APA style

• PowerPoint sample, 5 to 10 slides with speaker notes

• Confirmation statement below



Confirmation Statement



“I understand this is a nonprofit nursing and healthcare learning program testing participant role. I understand that I am not being asked to complete schoolwork, courses, exams, or assignments for another person. I understand originality checks may be used. AI generated writing is not allowed. AI may only be used for limited assistance. I will submit only original work and include proper APA citations where required. I also understand that quality work, reliability, and consistent communication are required.”



Required Documents



All documents must be clear and readable.



Please submit:



• Resume or portfolio

• Proof of graduation

• BSN diploma, front and back

• Transcript of Records, front and back

• Proof of GPA or academic standing, if available

• CHED verification of degree equivalency, if available

• RN license copy, front and back, if available



Incomplete or unclear submissions may not be reviewed.



Qualified applicants may be invited for a phone interview.



Please read the full post carefully before asking questions already answered here.



Apply only if you are serious, studious, reliable, respectful, academically strong, familiar with Canvas and Turnitin, comfortable with the honorarium budget, and ready to complete quality nursing and healthcare related academic work.

Current numbers



Right now: $92/day budget, ~6.87% conversion rate, ~NZ$76 CPA across two Search campaigns. Target is CPA under NZ$60 and conversion rate pushing toward 10%. 



Budget stays where it is until we can clearly see that more spend produces more quotes at a reasonable cost. Once we're there, that conversation happens quickly.



The work



Each week:



Review search terms, add negatives, cut spend that isn't converting

Adjust bids based on what's actually working

Short
 update: spend, conversions, CPA, what you changed and why



Each month:



Test ad copy — write new headlines, run them against current, cut the losers

Review how budget is split across campaigns

One-page summary: what moved, what didn't, what's next



As needed:



Propose new campaigns or restructures when you see an opportunity

Flag wasted spend before it runs long

Raise anything structural worth changing before the algorithm adapts to it

If you think
 Ads or 
 can drive more quotes cost-effectively, bring the proposal. We've underinvested in both. A past
 campaign ran at 0% conversion but we believe that was a tracking problem, not a channel problem. If you have a view on whether those channels are worth revisiting, we want to hear it.





How we work

 is the default. WhatsApp if something's urgent. A monthly call is available if you think it helps keep things aligned, but it's not required as long as the numbers are moving.



You get full editor access. Day-to-day optimisation is yours to make. Anything that changes overall budget or campaign strategy needs a quick sign-off first.



If you get the numbers moving, the scope grows with it. More campaigns, new channels, higher budget — that all gets scoped and paid separately. The base engagement is small by design. We grow it together once we can see the return.



What we need



3+ years managing Google Search for local or service businesses

A track record of actually lowering CPA, not just managing spend — bring a specific example

Strong negative keyword discipline (this is where most budgets bleed)

Comfortable with Smart Bidding and when tCPA makes sense vs when to hold off

Writes ad copy aimed at people likely to book, not just anyone searching

Useful but not required: experience with home services or trades in NZ or AU. Familiarity with GA4 conversion tracking is a plus — we've had tracking issues in the past and want someone who notices that kind of thing early.



To apply



Send an
 with:



One account you improved — what CPA looked like when you started, what you got it to, and the main things you changed

Your rate for roughly 4 hours per week

When you can start

One thing worth thinking about before you apply: given a 6.87% CVR on Maximize Conversions with a $92/day budget, what would your first two weeks look like?

title: Junior Developer - AI-Augmented Product & Tooling Team
description:
USD Pay · Long-Term · Philippines



What We're Building



We build AI-powered consumer products, custom developer tooling, and client solutions across multiple verticals:

AI image and video generation — a mobile and web app that transforms photos into stylized artwork using generative AI. Single Flutter codebase, Firebase backend, multiple AI model integrations.



Game development — interactive experiences with structured world-building and AI-assisted content generation.



Prompt research and skills tooling — we built a package manager for AI agent prompts and skills that detects your repo's tech stack and ranks results accordingly. We research how prompts perform across different models, build reusable skill packages that any AI coding agent can load, and maintain a catalog of 30+ skills covering everything from security review to prompt quality self-assessment. This isn't a side project — it's a core product.



MCP and agent workflow research — we actively research and build integrations using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and other emerging standards that reduce friction between developers and AI agents. We've built coordination servers that let multiple agents reserve files, message each other, and avoid conflicts. We've built tmux-based orchestration so developers can run 3-5 AI agents in parallel. When a new protocol, tool, or workflow pattern emerges, we evaluate it against real work and adopt or build what's missing.



Code quality tooling for agentic development — AI agents write a lot of code fast. The bottleneck isn't speed, it's confidence. We built compiler-integrated mutation testing and code quality metrics in Rust and TypeScript — tools that use each language's native AST parser so agents and developers can trust that generated code actually works. These aren't standalone research projects; they're the quality backbone that makes high-velocity agentic development safe.

Infrastructure and DevOps — Kubernetes clusters, CI/CD pipelines, private networking, infrastructure-as-code across all projects.



How We Work

We follow a pattern that defines the team culture: see a gap ? research what's available ? build it or adopt the best option ? ship it ? share it with the team.

We needed mutation testing tuned to our languages — generic linters couldn't handle Rust's error propagation or TypeScript's union types correctly. So we built compiler-integrated tools that use each language's native AST parser. We needed AI coding agents to coordinate without stepping on each other's files. So we built an MCP coordination server and a tmux orchestrator. We needed an issue tracker that works inside AI agent sessions. So we ported an open-source one to Rust and integrated it into the workflow. We needed to understand why some prompts waste tokens and others don't. So we built a prompt quality analyzer that extracts your messages from session logs, rates them, and shows you exactly where you're losing efficiency.



A new AI model drops on OpenRouter — by the end of the week, someone on the team has tested it against our workflow and reported back. A new MCP server appears on GitHub — someone's already evaluated whether it solves a real problem for us. A new 
 tool shows up on
 — someone's tried it in a real session. This isn't a scheduled R&D activity. It's how the team operates.



The internal tools are mostly Rust and Go. The products are Flutter and TypeScript. Client work varies — we recently picked up a Drupal project, and the expectation was that the team could ramp on an unfamiliar framework in a day using AI-assisted exploration. That's the skill we hire for.



What Makes This Team Different

Every developer works alongside AI coding agents as core workflow — not as an experiment. You'll have:

5 AI coding runtimes at your workstation (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Cursor)

30+ custom agent skills covering security, testing, architecture, code review, and prompt quality analysis

Multi-agent coordination via MCP so you can run several AI assistants on different tasks simultaneously without file conflicts

Automated quality gates (mutation testing, code metrics, security scanning, bug scanning) that give you confidence in AI-generated code before it hits review



Prompt research tools that help you measure and improve how effectively you communicate with AI agents

We don't just use these tools. We build them, research the protocols behind them, improve them, and expect every developer to have opinions about what works and what doesn't.

What We Expect From You



You experiment before you're told to. When a new AI model, CLI tool, MCP server, or workflow appears — on
, Hacker News, a 
, wherever — your instinct is to install it and try it. Not bookmark it. Not wait for a tea
eting. Try it, form a view, share what you found.



You assess your own work. We have tools that analyze prompt quality, code review effectiveness, and development patterns. You're expected to run them on yourself, identify your own anti-patterns, and fix them. Nobody will chase you to do this.

You learn by doing, not by reading. Our onboarding gives you access to the full environment on day one. We expect you to explore it. Open things, break things, ask questions when you're stuck — but try first. If we hand you a framework you've never seen before, the expectation is that you and your AI agents figure it out together — fast.



You communicate early, not late. Blocked for 30 minutes? Say something. Found a problem nobody mentioned? Flag it. A process doesn't make sense? Push back. Silence is the only wrong answer.



You follow through. When you pick up a task, you own it until it's done — including tests, docs, and letting the team know it's complete.



What the Work Looks Like

Build and ship features in Flutter (Dart) and Firebase Functions (TypeScript)

Contribute to internal Rust and Go tooling as you grow into the stack

Research and evaluate new AI models, MCP integrations, and developer tools

Integrate AI models for image generation, video generation, and content moderation

Pick up unfamiliar frameworks for client projects using AI-assisted exploration

Conduct peer reviews that actually catch problems — not rubber stamps

Evaluate new tools, models, and workflows as they emerge and share findings with the team

Run self-assessments on your development practices and discuss results at standups

Improve the team's engineering standards — our docs are living documents, not commandments



Tech Stack

Products:

Flutter (Dart) — iOS, Android, web from one codebase

Firebase Functions Gen 2, Node.js 25, TypeScript

Firestore, Cloud Storage, Stripe

OpenAI API, Google Gemini, Vision API



Internal Tooling:

Rust — mutation testing, code quality metrics, issue tracking, bug scanning

Go — AI skill package management, multi-agent orchestration, MCP coordination servers

Infrastructure:

Kubernetes, Forgejo (self-hosted git), Jenkins CI/CD

Ansible, OpenTofu, Semaphore, SAST/DAST and other security tooling

Lefthook, oxlint, Prettier, Spectral, Checkov, gitleaks, semgrep



You don't need to know all of this on day one. You need to be the kind of person who starts exploring it on day one.

Schedule



The team currently works 4pm–12am PHT (Manila time), but other schedules overlapping with US Eastern business hours can also be accommodated. We work this window as a team. As we grow, we plan to introduce flexible scheduling as additional teams are creating with other schedules.



Compensation

We're a bootstrapped startup pre-launch, looking for junior developers who are hungry to build real skills on real products. Starting compensation is junior-rate USD, paid via OnlineJobs.ph / Payoneer. Compensation scales once we launch and have revenue — early tea
mbers who prove themselves will be first in line for increases.



What you get:

Production experience shipping AI consumer products with professional engineering practices

Daily hands-on experience with AI coding tools and internal Rust/Go tooling most developers never touch

Exposure to prompt engineering research, MCP integrations, and agent workflow design

Direct mentorship on a small team — no layers between you and decisions

USD income with growth tied directly to company growth

A real voice in how the team works and what tools we build next



How to Apply

Step 1: Pick any AI coding tool you haven't used before — Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, RooCode, Kiro, GitHub Copilot, anything. Spend 30 minutes using it on a small task (a personal project, a tutorial, a three.js game, a port of a popular utility into Rust, a throwaway script — doesn't matter).

Step 2: Send your application with:

What you built with the AI tool — what you tried, what surprised you, whether you'd use it again. A few sentences is fine. We don't care which tool or whether you liked it. We care that you tried it and formed a view.

A project you've built that you're proud of (link or description)

Your experience with Flutter, TypeScript, Rust or similar

Your availability (full-time or part-time)

Your expected monthly rate (USD)

title: Inbox Manager
description:
Are you the person who keeps the inbox from becoming chaos?



Do you notice the difference between a real prospect reply, an out-of-office, a referral, a bounce, and someone politely saying "not now"? Do you like clear rules, clean labels, organized CRM records, and fast follow-up?



If you are careful, responsive, and genuinely enjoy making sure every message gets handled the right way, this may be a strong fit.



Why this role exists



We run outbound campaigns for B2B service companies. When prospects reply, those replies need to be read, categorized, answered, logged, and followed up quickly. If that workflow gets sloppy, good leads get missed and client reporting becomes unreliable.



We are hiring an Inbox Manager to own that daily response workflow. You will not be expected to design strategy or close deals. Your job is to keep the response engine clean, fast, and accurate.



This role is opening because one of our current tea
mbers is changing schedules, and we need dedicated coverage for inbox work.



Why work with us



- Fully remote contractor role with clear SOPs and a defined workflow

- Direct support from leadership during training

- Long-term opportunity for someone who is reliable and precise

- Work that rewards consistency, judgment, and careful communication

- Clear expectations and measurable performance standards

- A team that cares about clean systems and fast execution



What you'll be doing



Daily Inbox Triage

- Monitor campaign inboxes during the agreed coverage window.

- Separate warmup
s, bounces, out-of-office replies, unsubscribe requests, neutral replies, positive replies, referrals, bid requests, and call-booking opportunities.

- Apply the correct labels/dispositions so reporting stays accurate.

- Escalate hot leads, bid requests, and unclear cases quickly.



Replies and Follow-Up

- Use approved response templates and edit them so they sound natural and address the prospect's actual message.

- Reply within the required SLA during coverage hours.

- Schedule send-later replies when a prospect is outside their business hours.

- Create follow-up tasks when a reply needs future action.

- Make sure no real lead is left without a next step.



CRM Hygiene

- Add or update contacts in OutreachSphere Direct CRM when the SOP requires it.

- Include all relevant contacts on a thread, including CC'd referrals when appropriate.

- Keep tags, contact details, notes, and next steps accurate.

- Process unsubscribes, undeliverables, and do-not-contact requests same business day.



You'll crush this role if you...



- Are fast, careful, and responsive during your working hours

- Write clear professional English without sounding robotic

- Naturally organize information and follow checklists

- Can make good judgment calls when a reply is ambiguous

- Are comfortable using templates while still personalizing the final message

- Have experience with inbox management, CRM updates, sales support, customer support, or lead follow-up

- Are honest when you are unsure and escalate instead of guessing

- Like repetitive operational work and find satisfaction in getting it right every time

- Can learn tools like Missive, Smartlead, GoHighLevel, or similar CRMs



This role is not for you if...



- You want a creative strategy role

- You get bored by repetitive queue work

- You are slow to respond during your working hours

- You dislike detailed labeling, CRM updates, or process documentation

- You improvise instead of following approved templates and rules

- You need someone checking on you constantly to stay on task

- Written English is difficult for you



HOW TO APPLY



Submit your application here: 



The application takes about 10 minutes and includes a short personalized video. Applications without a video submission will not be reviewed.



Strong candidates will hear from us within 24 hours.

CPA – Churches & Ministry Accounting (Remote Contract Role)



We are a specialized church and ministry accounting practice (
) focused exclusively on supporting churches, Christian ministries, and faith-based non-profits across Canada.



Our work is not general bookkeeping. It is centered on church finance systems, donation stewardship, fund accounting, payroll structures, and CRA charity compliance. Our clients depend on us not only for accurate bookkeeping, but for reliable financial reporting that supports ministry leadership and stewardship decisions.



This is a fully remote contractor role, designed for experienced accountants who are comfortable working with Canadian organizations in a structured, deadline-driven environment. We operate fully virtually from Vancouver, BC.

________________________________________

Why this role is different

This is not general bookkeeping or outsourcing work.

You will be working in a specialized church accounting environment, where accuracy, consistency, and understanding of ministry operations are essential. Your work directly supports:

• Church leadership and board decision-making 

• Donation stewardship and fund accountability 

• CRA-compliant charity reporting 

• Payroll and pastoral compensation structures

What our tea
mbers value

Remote accountants working with us value:

• Working in a specialized niche (church & nonprofit accounting) rather than general bookkeeping 

• A fully remote, structured workflow environment 

• The opportunity to support meaningful, mission-driven organizations 

• Long-term working relationships with Canadian church clients 

• Exposure to Canadian charity compliance and fund accounting practices 

• Ongoing coaching, feedback, and process support 

• Using modern accounting and church management systems 

________________________________________

Details of the Role

Many churches and ministries struggle with bookkeeping, reporting, and compliance—not because they lack heart, but because they lack time and financial expertise.

In this role, you will help churches:

• Maintain clean, accurate, and audit-ready books 

• Meet CRA charity and payroll requirements 

• Provide clear financial reports to pastors, boards, and congregations 

• Give ministry leaders peace of mind so they can focus on their mission 

________________________________________

Core Responsibilities

• Full-cycle bookkeeping for churches and registered charities 

• Monthly bank and credit card reconciliations 

• Donation and fund tracking (restricted and unrestricted funds) 

• Payroll (pastors, staff, housing allowances, benefits) 

• Accounts payable & receivable 

• GST/HST rebate tracking for charities 

• Financial statements and variance analysis for boards 

• Year-end preparation and coordination with external auditors 

• Supporting compliance with CRA charity rules and best practices 

________________________________________

Technology Stack

• QuickBooks Online and QuickBooks Desktop 

• TaxDome for workflow, task management, and client communication 

• Church and ministry platforms including PowerChurch, 
, and Planning Center 

• Additional tools may include Hubdoc, Wagepoint, Plooto, Google Workspace, Zoom, and other best-in-class nonprofit and church accounting tools 

• You must be comfortable learning and adopting new web-based software quickly 

________________________________________

Job Fit Criteria

To be considered a strong fit, you must meet the following:

• Minimum 2–3 years of experience using QuickBooks Online or Desktop in a professional bookkeeping or accounting capacity 

• Educational background in accounting (college diploma, certificate, degree, or equivalent training) 

• Experience working with churches, charities, or nonprofits (highly valued) 

• Available for 15–30 hours per week, working remotely 

• Able to update books at least every 2–3 days and respond to
s within 2–3 business hours 

• Certified and experienced in QuickBooks Online 

• Strong ability to work independently in a structured remote environment with deadlines and systems 

• Own computer, fast internet, and a professional, quiet home office suitable for video calls 

• Experience preparing year-end working papers and supporting audits or reviews is highly desirable

Founded in 2014 in Chicago, Illinois, Uncap is a design and development agency specializing in Shopify and Shopify Plus solutions.  Benefits

title: Video Editor – Shorts, Long-Form and Trailers DaVinci Resolve
description:
We want a Video Editor who actually cares - someone who watches tutorials on their days off, studies what's working, and notices when captions are 2 pixels off. If you're constantly learning and improving, keep reading. If you're just looking for any editing job, this isn't it.



You'll edit across three formats:



Short-form clips - Reels, TikToks, Shorts. Finding the best 
nts, crafting hooks, making videos people actually watch.



Long-form episodes - Full podcast edits. Pacing, cuts, audio polish, making hour-long conversations feel tight.



Trailers - Cinematic, high-energy promotional videos (think Diary Of A CEO style). These need real editing chops - dramatic pacing, music, powerful 
nts strung together.



Design matters here. Your videos need to look polished - title cards, captions, graphics, layouts. If you don't have a good eye for design, this role will frustrate you.



This role is right for you if you:



- Are always learning - you seek out new techniques, watch breakdowns, stay curious

- Can edit both quick social clips AND polished long-form content

- Get excited about creating trailers that give people chills

- Have a sharp eye for 
nts that will hit

- Care about design - your captions, titles, and graphics look intentional, not default

- Can work fast without dropping quality

- Take pride in clean, polished edits



The Right Person Will:

- Have a strong portfolio showing range - short-form clips, long-form edits, and ideally trailers or promo videos (no portfolio, no consideration)

- Have a good eye for design - your title cards, captions, and graphics look polished, not like default templates

- Be a genuine learner - you actively improve your skills, seek feedback, and stay on top of what's working

- Know DaVinci Resolve well - multi-cam, colour correction, proxies, basic audio in Fairlight

- Have motion graphics skills - we use Fusion inside Resolve, but After Effects experience transfers (you can learn Fusion quickly)

- Understand short-form trends: hooks, pacing, captions, what works on TikTok/Reels/Shorts

- Know how to edit for emotion - trailers require pacing, music selection, and building to 
nts

- Care about details - no sloppy captions, no audio issues, no "good enough"

- Be a self-starter who manages their own time and hits deadlines

- Stay organized when handling lots of source files and outputs

- Communicate clearly in English (written and spoken)

- Be comfortable with cloud tools and open to AI workflows (transcription, clip finding)

- (Bonus) Have a genuine interest in podcasts or content creation

- (Bonus) Familiar with Figma, Photoshop, Canva, or other design tools for graphics/thumbnails



What You'll Do:



Short-Form Clips:

- Watch long-form podcasts and find the best 
nts for clips

- Edit vertical videos with strong hooks, good pacing, captions, graphics, music, and sound effects

- Keep turnaround times fast while maintaining quality

- Adapt style for different platforms and client brands



Long-Form Episodes:

- Edit full podcast episodes - pacing, cuts, removing dead air, keeping energy up

- Handle multi-cam footage, sync audio/video, colour correction

- Create and work with proxy files for efficient workflows

- Polish audio and ensure consistent levels throughout



Trailers & Promos:

- Create cinematic trailers that build excitement for episodes or shows

- Select the most powerful 
nts and string them together with music and pacing

- Edit for emotion - know when to hit hard and when to breathe

- Think Diary Of A CEO style: high energy, dramatic, makes you want to watch



Quality & Workflow:

- Review your own work carefully before delivery - technical quality, accuracy, brand consistency

- Ensure all design elements look polished - titles, captions, graphics should look intentional

- Keep project files and cloud assets organized

- Work smoothly with the team using our project management and communication tools

- Create thumbnails and graphics when needed (design eye required)



Technical Requirements (Must Have):

- Strong DaVinci Resolve experience (this is mandatory)

- Motion graphics experience - Fusion (preferred) or After Effects (you'll learn Fusion)

- Multi-cam editing experience in Resolve

- Comfortable with proxy workflows

- Basic audio editing (Fairlight is fine)

- Fast, reliable internet (we'll ask for a speed test)

- Powerful editing computer (we'll ask for your specs)

- Familiar with cloud storage (Google Drive, Dropbox, etc.)



Bonus Skills (Nice to Have)

- Experience creating trailers or promo videos

- Strong graphic design skills (Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator)

- Advanced motion graphics - complex animations, 3D elements, expressions

- Great music selection instincts - you know what tracks elevate edits

- Advanced audio editing/mixing

- Short-form videos that have performed well on social media

- Experience with AI tools for video workflows



Perks:

Work Hours: Australia time (AEST), with good overlap for Philippines (PHT)

Flexible Schedule: Choose your set hours within the collaborative window

Time Off: Flexible leave policy with reasonable notice

Growth: Opportunities for advancement, raises, and bonuses for consistent quality work

Good Team: Remote, forward-thinking, no micromanagement



About Us:

We're an Australia-based content company that produces podcasts and short-form video. We use DaVinci Resolve, efficient workflows, and focus on delivering quality work at volume.



Salary:



40-45,000 PHP + per month



If your experience and portfolio justify a higher rate, tell us upfront. We're open to negotiation for the right person.





How to Apply:

Follow these steps carefully (this tests your attention to detail):



 subject line:

Application: Video Editor (Shorts, Long-Form & Trailers) – [Your Full Name]



In your
, write 2–3 sentences about:



Why this role appeals to you

Which format excites you most - clips, long-form, or trailers - and why

What makes you different to other editors

Tell us how you learn:

Complete this quick test (5–10 minutes):

Include a link to your portfolio/showreel - we want to see:

Long-form editing samples if you have them

Trailers or promo videos (if you have them - big plus)

(We will not consider applications without video examples)



Include:

We are looking for an experienced **Meta Ads Manager** to help build, manage, and optimize paid advertising campaigns for our ecommerce supplement brand.



This role is ideal for someone who has hands-on experience running Meta ads for ecommerce brands, understands direct-response marketing, and can actively manage campaigns rather than simply setting them up and letting them run.



## About the Role



We are starting from the ground up with Meta advertising. We do not currently have prior campaign data, audience insights, or historical performance to share, so we need someone who is comfortable building campaigns from scratch, testing different angles, and making data-driven optimizations.



We already have UGC-style ad creatives ready to go and are looking to launch with an estimated ad spend of around **$100 per day**. The goal is to generate profitable sales, attract new customers, and maintain a strong ROI as campaigns scale.



This is a **part-time role** requiring roughly **4–5 hours per day** of active management, monitoring, testing, and optimization.



## Responsibilities



* Build Meta ad campaigns from the ground up, including campaign structure, audiences, placements, budgets, and testing strategy

* Launch, monitor, and optimize campaigns using provided UGC ad creatives

* Create and manage testing strategies for creatives, hooks, audiences, copy, offers, and landing pages

* Actively monitor campaign performance and make ongoing improvements

* Optimize campaigns for purchases, customer acquisition, ROI, ROAS, CPA, and conversion rate

* Provide regular updates on performance, key insights, and recommended next steps

* Identify winning creatives, audiences, and messaging angles

* Help scale profitable campaigns while maintaining efficiency

* Troubleshoot underperforming campaigns and make strategic adjustments



## Requirements



* Proven experience managing Meta Ads for ecommerce brands

* Strong understanding of
 and Instagram advertising

* Ability to build campaigns from scratch with no existing data

* Experience optimizing for conversions, ROAS, CPA, and customer acquisition

* Familiarity with UGC-style creatives and direct-response ad strategy

* Comfortable working with a daily ad budget of around $100

* Strong analytical skills and ability to make decisions based on performance data

* Reliable communication and willingness to provide ongoing performance updates

* Must be proactive and actively involved in campaign management



## Preferred Experience



* Experience working with supplement, health, wellness, fitness, or men’s lifestyle brands

* Experience with Shopify or ecommerce landing pages

* Ability to assist with ad copy, creative direction, or content strategy

* Experience helping brands improve conversion rates

* Familiarity with compliance-sensitive categories such as supplements

* Ability to support organic social media posting across platforms such as Instagram, TikTok,
, and other channels



## Bonus Skills



This is not required, but it would be a major plus if you can also assist with:



* Content creation strategy

* UGC creative direction

* Social media management

* Posting across multiple platforms

* Writing ad copy and hooks

* Helping plan new creative angles based on ad performance

* Basic landing page or funnel recommendations



## Budget



Our expected management budget is approximately **$500–$800 per month**, depending on experience, skill level, and scope of work.



Ad spend will be separate from management fees and will start at around **$100 per day**.



## Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is someone who understands ecommerce growth, can move quickly, tests aggressively, communicates clearly, and knows how to manage Meta campaigns with the goal of profitable customer acquisition.



We are not looking for someone to simply set up campaigns and disappear. We need active management, regular optimization, and someone who can help us find winning campaigns as we grow.
