title: Sales & Customer Service
description:
We are a residential cleaning company based in North Carolina, USA, and we have been serving Triangle-area families since 2016. We currently serve over 57 recurring residential clients and we are growing. We are hiring a full-time, remote Sales and Customer Service Representative to manage our residential clients and convert new leads into booked recurring services.

This is not a data entry job. This is not a passive support role. You will be the first voice a potential client hears, and you will be the ongoing relationship owner for our existing clients. If you are someone who takes ownership of your results, stays on top of follow-up without being reminded, and genuinely enjoys talking to people and solving problems — read on.



What You Will Do

You will respond to all inbound residential leads and conduct discovery calls to understand what clients need. You will close recurring cleaning bookings, not one-time services. You will manage post-service check-ins with existing clients, handle rescheduling and service concerns, and work to keep our clients happy and retained. You will log all activity in our CRM (GoHighLevel) and submit daily and weekly reports to ownership. You will also request Google reviews from satisfied clients and support our referral program.



Your Schedule

This is a full-time role, Monday through Friday, Eastern Standard Time (EST). You must be available and online during these hours. This means your working hours will be in the evening and nighttime in the Philippines. Please only apply if this schedule works for you.



What We Need From You

You need at least two years of experience in sales, customer service, or client relations — service industry experience is preferred. You need a strong, clear phone voice. You need to be comfortable following up consistently without dropping the ball. You need experience using a CRM or similar platform. GoHighLevel experience is a big plus. You must have a dedicated home workspace, stable and fast internet, a reliable computer, and a headset. You must be available during US Eastern Time business hours.



What We Offer

This is a full-time remote position with a competitive base salary and a performance bonus tied to your conversion rate, client retention, and Google review activity. We are a stable, growing company. We do not micromanage. We expect you to own your results and show up ready to work every day.



Our Culture

We operate on five core values: Show Up and Follow Through. Do the Right Thing Even When No One Is Looking. Own Your Results. Support the Team. Protect the Brand. If these values match how you already work, you will fit here.

title: Senior Procurement Specialist
description:
Full-Time | Remote 



Reports to: Chief Operating Officer



About the role

We are a fast-growing pet products company selling direct-to-consumer and through retail channels. Our products include manufactured and finished goods sourced primarily from China, with additional vendors in the US.



This is a newly created role — the first dedicated procurement hire in our company. The successful candidate will consolidate purchasing currently spread across multiple people, establish supplier relationships, create spend visibility, and build the systems and discipline that will support our growth.



Key responsibilities

• Consolidate all purchasing activity into a single, managed process covering raw materials, components, and finished goods

• Own the full supplier lifecycle: identification, vetting, onboarding, negotiation, and ongoing relationship management

• Manage USD 10–14M in annual spend across the supplier base, primarily in China

• Negotiate pricing, lead times, payment terms, and volume contracts with existing and new suppliers

• Issue and track purchase orders end-to-end, from requisition to receipt

• Align purchasing with inventory targets using our WMS (Finale Inventory) and demand planning inputs

• Build and maintain an Approved Vendor List (AVL) and supplier scorecard

• Identify cost savings opportunities and report on spend vs. budget to leadership

• Coordinate with freight forwarders and manage import logistics for inbound shipments from Asia

• Proactively flag supply chain risks and develop contingency plans



Required qualifications:

• Minimum 5 years of experience in procurement, sourcing, or supply chain management

• Proven experience sourcing from Chinese factories or trading companies

• Strong written and spoken English communication skills

• Demonstrated experience building or significantly improving a purchasing process

• Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, low-structure environment

• Solid understanding of import logistics, Incoterms, and freight coordination

• Prior experience working for a US-based or global company with remote/async work expectations



Preferred qualifications:

• Experience with WMS or inventory management tools (Finale Inventory training provided)

• Background in consumer products, pet products, or e-commerce supply chains

• Familiarity with quality control processes for manufactured goods

• CPSM or CSCP certification

• Experience configuring an ERP or procurement module

• Mandarin language skills (written or spoken)



Work setup:

This is a fully remote, asynchronous-first position. Written communication is the default. You will document decisions, maintain purchasing status in shared trackers, and communicate proactively without relying on calls.



The Philippines time zone (UTC+8) aligns with Chinese business hours, enabling real-time supplier communication during your regular workday. You will have a defined spend authority threshold for routine purchases and will report directly to the COO with a weekly async check-in.



90-day success milestones:

• All active suppliers identified and documented in a centralized supplier register

• All purchasing activity consolidated under this role

• A standardized purchase order process established and consistently followed

• Full spend visibility by category delivered to leadership

• Top supplier contracts reviewed with renegotiation initiated on a minimum of three

Please submit your resume via Google Drive link to be CONSIDERED for this position.

description:
### Position Overview



We are seeking an experienced SEO and Digital Growth Specialist who can help increase our online visibility, improve Google rankings, generate qualified leads, and position our company as a trusted authority in the luxury home remodeling industry.



The ideal candidate has proven experience with local SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, AI search visibility, content strategy, keyword research, and website optimization. Social media experience is a plus, but the primary focus of this role is driving organic traffic, search rankings, and lead generation through Google and emerging AI search platforms.

* Analyze competitors and identify opportunities to outperform them in local search results.

* Create SEO-focused content recommendations for blogs, project showcases, FAQs, and service pages.

* Provide monthly reports outlining performance, growth opportunities, and recommendations.

* Support social media content planning to ensure alignment with SEO and search visibility goals.



### Qualifications



* Minimum 3+ years of proven SEO experience.

* Strong understanding of Local SEO, Technical SEO, On-Page SEO, and Content SEO.

* Experience optimizing Google Business Profiles and local service businesses.

* Experience working with remodeling, construction, architecture, home improvement, or related industries preferred.

* Knowledge of AI search optimization and emerging search trends.

* Experience with SEO tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Search Console, Google Analytics, BrightLocal, or similar platforms.

* Strong content strategy and keyword research skills.

* Ability to translate SEO efforts into measurable lead generation results.

* Excellent analytical and reporting capabilities.

* Understanding of social media content strategy and its impact on search visibility.



### Required Application Materials



To be considered, applicants must submit:

* Resume and relevant certifications.

* Their SEO experience.

* How they would improve our website's rankings.

title: SEO Content Writer & Link Builder
description:
ABOUT TEE VISION PRINTING

Tee Vision Printing is a B2B custom screen printing and branded apparel shop based in Philadelphia, PA. We serve schools, nonprofits, businesses, sports teams, and events nationwide. We are actively growing our online presence and domain authority, and we need a content-focused tea
mber to help us build real, sustainable backlinks through quality writing and smart outreach.



ABOUT THIS ROLE

You will work directly under our Backlink Team Lead, who manages client relationships, local directory submissions, and high-level outreach strategy. Your job is to do the content execution that drives referring domains — writing the blogs, building the guest posts, doing the research, and helping us get placed on relevant sites.

This is not a link scheme role. We build links the right way — through content people actually want to publish and read.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Write original blog posts for our website targeting SEO keywords in the custom apparel, screen printing, and branded merchandise space

• Research and identify guest posting opportunities on relevant blogs, trade publications, marketing sites, small business sites, and local Philadelphia-area publications

• Write and pitch guest post articles to site editors on behalf of Tee Vision Printing

• Write case studies based on real client orders (details provided by our team) — structured to earn links from referenced organizations

• Assist with LinkedIn content creation: short-form posts, thought leadership angles, and content that supports the team's outreach efforts

• Track outreach progress and placement results in a shared spreadsheet

• Follow our internal brand voice and SEO content guidelines on every piece



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

This is not a PBN or link farm role. We do not buy links. We do not use spun content. Every piece of content you write must be original, accurate, and genuinely useful. If that is not how you work, this role is not for you.



REQUIREMENTS — MUST HAVE

• Proven experience writing SEO-optimized blog content in English — samples required

• Experience with guest post outreach: finding targets, writing pitches, getting placements

• Ability to write in a clear, professional, human voice — not AI-sounding

• Comfortable researching industries you're not already an expert in

• Strong written English — grammar, clarity, and tone all matter

• Organized and self-directed — you can manage a content calendar without hand-holding

• Familiar with basic SEO concepts: anchor text, domain authority, follow vs. nofollow, keyword targeting



NICE TO HAVE

• Experience writing for e-commerce, apparel, print, or B2B service businesses

• Familiarity with Ahrefs, SEMrush, or Moz for link prospecting

• LinkedIn content writing experience

• Experience writing case studies

• Understanding of link building metrics: DR, DA, traffic, relevance



WHAT WE PROVIDE

• Clear briefs for every blog post — keyword, angle, target length, internal linking instructions

• Brand voice guide and writing standards

• Case study source material — you write it, we provide the order details

• Team lead oversight and review on all guest post pitches before they go out

• Direct feedback loop — you're not writing into a void

HOW TO APPLY

Send the following to apply. Applications without writing samples will not be reviewed.



• Your resume or work history summary

• 2–3 writing samples — blog posts or guest posts you have written (published links preferred)

• A brief paragraph explaining your guest post outreach process — how do you find sites and get placements?

• One sentence: what is your understanding of domain authority and why does it matter for link building?

title: SEO Content Writer & On-Page Optimizer — Tee Vision Printing
description:
ABOUT US

Tee Vision Printing is a Philadelphia-based custom screen printing company serving businesses, schools, nonprofits, sports teams, and events. We've been operating since 2012 and are in an aggressive growth phase — building out a full SEO and content strategy to become the #1 screen printing brand in the Philadelphia market and beyond.

We have a clear roadmap, a keyword strategy already built, content brief templates ready to use, and a UX/UI designer waiting on content to build pages. We are not starting from scratch — we need someone to execute what's already been planned.

This is a long-term role with real room to grow.



HOW WE WORK — READ THIS FIRST

We use Claude AI as a drafting tool. Your job is NOT to write everything from scratch and it is NOT to copy-paste whatever AI generates. Your job is to:



Fill out our content brief template for each page or blog (keyword, audience, word count, internal links, page goal)

Use the pre-written Claude prompt from the brief to generate a first draft

Edit, optimize, and improve that draft — fix keyword placement, add local Philadelphia context, correct any errors, ensure it matches our brand voice

Verify the SEO is correct — right keywords in the right heading levels, meta title under 60 characters, internal links pointing to the right pages on our actual site

Submit the final version to the business owner for approval, then hand off to our UX/UI designer to build the page



You are the quality control layer between AI output and what goes live on our site. If Claude gets something wrong — a local detail, a keyword in the wrong place, a heading that doesn't match our strategy — you catch it and fix it. This requires you to genuinely understand SEO, not just follow instructions blindly.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

On-Page SEO Optimization (first 30-60 days — highest priority)



Go through our existing pages one by one using our provided keyword map

Write or rewrite meta titles, meta descriptions, H1s, and H2s for each page

Write optimized body copy for new audience and service landing pages

Ensure every page targets the correct primary and secondary keywords without cannibalization

Update internal links across existing blogs so they point to the correct landing pages

Fix existing blog meta titles that are over 60 characters (we have a list ready)



New Page Creation (ongoing)



Write landing page copy for audience pages: education, sports, nonprofits, business, events, and more

Each page follows our hub-and-spoke site architecture — you need to understand how pages connect

All pages go through the brief ? Claude draft ? your edits ? approval ? designer workflow



Blog Content (ongoing)



Write 2-3 SEO-optimized blog posts per week

Topics, keywords, and structure are pre-planned — you execute the brief, not pick your own topics

Each blog targets a specific keyword, audience, and internal linking goal

Blogs are part of our "Wikipedia of printing" strategy — comprehensive, citable, AI-friendly content



Light Outreach Support



Write guest post outreach
s to help secure backlinks (templates provided)

No cold calling, no sales — just written outreach



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

Required:



Fluent written English — your writing must be clean, natural, and sound like a real person, not AI

At least 2 years of experience writing SEO content (blogs, landing pages, service pages)

Solid understanding of on-page SEO: keyword placement in titles and headings, meta title character limits, internal linking strategy, avoiding keyword cannibalization

Experience using Claude, ChatGPT, or similar AI tools — and knowing when the output needs fixing

Ability to follow a content brief exactly

Experience writing for US-based businesses or clients

Comfortable using Google Docs and basic CMS platforms



Strongly preferred:



Experience writing landing page copy AND blog content (both, not just one)

Familiarity with hub-and-spoke content architecture

Experience doing outreach
s for link building

Portfolio that includes local service business content (home services, trades, restaurants, professional services, or similar)



Not required:



Experience in screen printing or apparel (we'll train you on the industry)

Technical SEO skills

Design skills

Ahrefs or SEMrush (we provide all keyword data — you don't need to run your own research)





DELIVERABLES (what we expect per week)



2-3 fully optimized blog posts (800-1,500 words each)

2-3 landing page briefs completed, drafted, edited, and submitted

Meta title and description updates for 5-10 existing pages

Internal link updates across existing blogs as new pages go live





COMPENSATION



Full-time (40 hours/week)

Rate: negotiable based on experience — include your expected monthly rate in USD with your application

Long-term role — we are not looking for someone for a one-time project





HOW TO APPLY

Send the following — applications missing any of these four items will not be reviewed:

1. Two writing samples — one blog post AND one landing page or service page. Links or attached documents both fine. Show us you can do both, not just one.

2. Answer this question in 3-5 sentences: You are given a Claude AI draft for a screen printing company landing page. The draft is well-written but the primary keyword "t-shirt printing Philadelphia" only appears in the body copy — not in the H1, H2, or meta title. What do you do?

3. Write a meta title for this page: a screen printing company in Philadelphia targeting the keyword "t-shirt printing Philadelphia." Keep it under 60 characters.

4. Your expected monthly rate in USD.

We read every application and respond to every qualified applicant within 3 business days.



Tee Vision Printing — Philadelphia, PA

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
# Digital Marketing Specialist



## About Pelican Leads



Pelican Leads is a growing digital marketing agency that helps local service-based businesses generate more leads, increase revenue, and dominate their local markets. We work with businesses of all sizes across industries such as automotive, home services, contractors, and other local service providers.



We're a young company with ambitious growth plans and a strong focus on delivering measurable results for our clients. Our culture is professional but relaxed—we care far more about performance, quality, and efficiency than micromanaging employees. If you consistently produce excellent work and meet deadlines, you'll enjoy a high level of autonomy and flexibility.



Unlike many agencies where you're just another employee, this position offers significant room for growth. As Pelican Leads continues to expand, tea
mbers who demonstrate leadership, initiative, and strong results may have opportunities to advance into senior specialist, team lead, management, or department leadership roles.



If you're looking for a long-term opportunity where your contributions will directly impact the growth of both clients and the agency, we'd love to hear from you.



---



# Position: Digital Marketing Specialist



## Position Overview



We are seeking a highly skilled and results-driven Digital Marketing Specialist to join our team. This role requires a strong understanding of paid advertising, search engine optimization, local SEO, and lead generation strategies.



The ideal candidate can think strategically, execute independently, and consistently produce measurable results for clients. We're looking for someone who is proactive, detail-oriented, and passionate about digital marketing.



## Key Responsibilities



###
 & Instagram Advertising



* Create, manage, and optimize
 and Instagram advertising campaigns.

* Generate strong results even with limited advertising budgets.

* Build conversion-focused campaigns for local service businesses.

* Create audience targeting and retargeting campaigns.

* Monitor performance and continually improve campaign efficiency.

* Analyze data and make strategic optimizations based on results.



### Search Engine Optimization (SEO)



* Conduct comprehensive SEO audits and competitor research.

* Develop and execute local SEO strategies.

* Perform keyword research and content planning.

* Understand and implement topical authority strategies.

* Optimize websites for:



  * On-page SEO

  * Internal linking

  * Content structure

  * Metadata

  * Technical SEO

  * Schema markup

* Analyze backlink profiles and distinguish high-quality backlinks from low-quality or potentially harmful links.

* Assist with ethical link-building and authority-building initiatives.



### Google Business Profile Optimization



* Optimize and manage Google Business Profiles.

* Improve local map rankings and visibility.

* Maintain accurate business information.

* Publish posts and optimize service offerings.

* Monitor performance metrics and identify growth opportunities.

* Assist with review generation strategies and profile management.



### Google Ads (PPC)



* Create and manage Google Search campaigns.

* Conduct keyword research and campaign planning.

* Optimize bids, budgets, and conversion rates.

* Improve Quality Scores and overall campaign performance.

* Monitor lead quality and campaign ROI.



### Reporting & Analytics



* Track performance across all digital marketing channels.

* Prepare client reports and internal performance updates.

* Identify opportunities for optimization and growth.

* Make recommendations based on data and campaign results.



## Required Qualifications



* Proven experience running successful
 and Instagram advertising campaigns.

* Strong understanding of technical SEO.

* Experience building topical authority through content strategy.

* Ability to identify and evaluate high-quality vs. low-quality backlinks.

* Strong knowledge of local SEO best practices.

* Experience optimizing and managing Google Business Profiles.

* Experience managing Google Ads campaigns.

* Familiarity with Google Analytics and Google Search Console.

* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

* Reliable internet connection and equipment.



## Preferred Qualifications



* Experience working with local service businesses.

* Familiarity with GoHighLevel CRM.

* Experience using tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, BrightLocal, Local Falcon, or similar platforms.

* Understanding of call tracking, conversion tracking, and attribution systems.

* Experience creating SEO content briefs and content strategies.



## What We're Looking For



The ideal candidate is:



* Results-oriented

* Self-motivated

* Highly organized

* Proactive and resourceful

* Comfortable learning new systems

* Focused on continuous improvement

* Interested in growing with the company long-term



## Growth Opportunities



Pelican Leads is actively growing, and we believe in promoting from within whenever possible. Tea
mbers who consistently demonstrate exceptional performance, leadership, and initiative will be considered for future advancement opportunities as the company expands.



## Compensation



Compensation will be based on experience, skills, and demonstrated ability. Long-term opportunities and performance-based incentives may be available for exceptional tea
mbers.



## Application Instructions



To show that you read the full job description carefully, please include the phrase **“Pelican Leads Growth”** at the very top of your application.



Applications that do not include this phrase will not be reviewed.

???????????????????????????????????????????????

in Southern California. We handle residential and commercial

accounts. We use Jobber for all operations, Slack as our command

center, and QUO for phones. Everything runs through systems —

???????????????????????????????????????????????

We are looking for a mature, experienced, dependable professional

with a minimum of 5 years of real work experience — ideally in

the cleaning industry, home services, or field service operations.

professional stability, and reliability are more important to us

than anything else. If you are just starting out in your career

this is not the right position for you.



We have a small tight-knit team and are looking for someone who

will blend well with our existing team culture and take genuine

ownership of their role.



This is a long-term position with real growth opportunity.

If you show up, do the work correctly, and grow with us —

you will move up in this company. We promote from within.



???????????????????????????????????????????????



REQUIREMENTS — NON-NEGOTIABLE



You MUST meet all of the following or do not apply:



  • Minimum 5 years of professional work experience

  • Currently working or has worked in Pacific Standard Time (PST)

    business hours — 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM PST — for at least 1 year

  • Previous experience working as a VA for a cleaning company,

    home services company, or field service business

  • Knows how to use Jobber or a similar field service CRM

    such as Housecall Pro or ServiceTitan

  • Fluent in English — written and spoken — professional level

  • Reliable high-speed internet connection

  • Quiet, professional workspace at home

  • Stable work history — no job hopping

  • Available to start within 2 weeks



???????????????????????????????????????????????



TOOLS YOU MUST KNOW OR LEARN IMMEDIATELY

  • Slack — primary communication tool, you will live here

  • QUO / OpenPhone — answering calls and texts, managing inbox

  • Google LSA — responding to leads, managing the lead inbox

  • Microsoft 365 —
, SharePoint document management

  • PandaDoc — sending contracts and onboarding documents

  • Basic Zapier understanding is a plus



???????????????????????????????????????????????



YOUR DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES



Every single day you are responsible for:



LEAD MANAGEMENT

  • Monitor Google LSA inbox starting at 8:00 AM PST sharp

  • Respond to every new lead within 15 minutes of it coming in

  • Use the company pricing tool to generate accurate quotes

  • Assign cleaners to jobs and confirm their availability first

CLIENT COMMUNICATION

  • Respond to all client texts and calls through QUO professionally

  • Escalate any client complaints to ownership immediately

  • Never discuss pricing changes or make promises without approval



SLACK ACCOUNTABILITY

  • Post your daily check-in by 8:00 AM PST every workday

  • Confirm every completed task in the assigned Slack channels

  • Respond to all Slack messages within 15 minutes during work hours

  • Post any issues, problems, or questions in the correct channel

    immediately — do not wait



CLEANER COORDINATION

???????????????????????????????????????????????

HOURS AND SCHEDULE

title: Game Preview Video Creator (Browser Games) — Full-Time, Long-Term
description:
Plix.gg is a browser games portal with thousands of games, similar to Poki and CrazyGames. We're looking for an experienced video editor to create short gameplay preview clips for our game library at scale.

Visit our site: 

What you'll do:



Play browser games on Plix.gg and capture the most exciting gameplay 
nts (play for a few minutes first so clips aren't only from the very beginning of the game)

Edit short 8-10 second preview videos made of 3-6 clips each

Editing style is simple: no transitions, no effects — just clean hard cuts between clips. If the game is slow, speed the footage up so the preview feels fast. If the game is already fast-paced, normal speed is fine.

Export videos as 1080x1080 (1:1 square) MP4, 60fps, no audio, high quality. Record gameplay normally, then crop/punch in to square on the action — make sure the important gameplay stays centered in frame. Don't worry about file size — we handle compression and optimization on our side.



What we require:



Proven experience with video editing software such as Adobe Premiere, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut

Proficient with OBS Studio or similar screen recording software — you must already know how to set up recording profiles, adjust encoder settings, and record smooth 1080p60 gameplay on your own

Reliable internet connection and a computer that can run browser games smoothly while recording at 60fps

Strong attention to detail and consistency

Able to work independently in a high-volume, repeatable workflow

Full-time availability for long-term work



This role is NOT for beginners. We need someone who already knows their tools and can produce clean, sharp 1080p60 footage cropped to square from day one.

What makes a good preview:

Actual gameplay showing the core mechanic, clear action or satisfying 
nts, fast pacing, and visual variety across 3-6 clips.

What makes a bad preview:

Menus, loading screens, tutorial text, static or boring gameplay, choppy/laggy recording, or 
nts where nothing interesting is happening (unless the game itself is not exciting).

Pay:



PHP11,500 per week for 100 approved videos (average 20/day across 5 days — you choose which days)

Bonus: PHP30 for every approved video above 100 per week

Payment: Weekly for the first month, then biweekly or monthly via Wise or Payoneer, your choice



How approval works:

A video may be sent back for revision if it shows menus, loading screens, or tutorial overlays, does not show meaningful gameplay, feels too slow or repetitive, is choppy or below 60fps, or does not match naming or style guidelines.

We provide:

File naming rules, upload instructions, and ongoing feedback to help you improve speed and consistency.

Long-term opportunity:

We have thousands of games and continue adding more. If you are reliable and produce strong work consistently, this is a stable long-term role with potential for pay increases. We care about output, not rigid schedules. Need to skip Wednesday? Make it up Thursday or swap for a weekend day — your call. As long as you communicate in advance and weekly output stays consistent, we're happy. Base pay is guaranteed; the bonus rewards you when you're in the zone.

title: AI Video Editor
description:
# AI Video Ad Editor — Meta & YouTube Ads (Remote)



## About the Role



We're looking for a skilled AI Video Ad Editor to produce high-performing video ad creatives for Meta 
 & Instagram) and YouTube campaigns across financial services and SaaS verticals.



This is a full time role, fully remote - preference though is in Cavite, as we are thinking of opening an office there to save you commute into Manila. You'll be working directly with the founder and a small, fast-moving team that manages significant monthly ad spend and ships creative at pace.



You won't be shooting footage. You'll be assembling, editing, and producing scroll-stopping video ads using a combination of AI video tools, stock footage, screen recordings, motion graphics, and supplied brand assets — then iterating based on performance data.



## What You'll Be Doing



- Producing 2-5 short-form video ads per day (15s–90s) optimised for Meta and YouTube placements

- Working from creative briefs, scripts, and storyboards to assemble polished ad creatives

- Using AI video generation tools (Runway, Pika, Kling, HeyGen, Synthesia, Seedance, or similar) to produce b-roll, talking-head variants, and motion sequences

- Editing in CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or equivalent — whatever gets the job done fast and clean

- Adding captions, kinetic text, transitions, branded overlays, and CTAs that follow direct-response best practices

- Creating multiple hooks, angles, and format variants from a single script to enable rapid testing

- Adapting creatives across aspect ratios (9:16, 1:1, 16:9) for Stories, Reels, Feed, Shorts, and in-stream placements

- Incorporating performance feedback — when we tell you Hook 2 is winning and the mid-section drops off, you know what to do with that information

- Maintaining brand consistency across output while keeping the creative fresh and platform-native



## What We're Looking For



- Demonstrable experience editing direct-response video ads for Meta and/or YouTube (not brand/awareness — we need ads that convert)

- Fluency with at least two AI video generation tools and a willingness to stay current as the tooling evolves rapidly

- A strong eye for pacing, visual hierarchy, and the rhythm of ads that hold attention in a feed environment

- Understanding of direct-response principles: pattern interrupts, hook structures, benefit stacking, urgency, social proof integration

- Ability to work from a script and creative brief without needing hand-holding on every cut

- Fast turnaround — this is a performance marketing environment, not a production studio

- Clean file management and organised delivery of assets (named correctly, layered where needed, final exports in specified formats)

- Reliable communication and availability during UK business hours (GMT/BST), even if based in a different timezone



## Bonus Points



- Experience in financial services, lending, insurance, or regulated industry advertising

- Familiarity with UGC-style ad formats and how to produce them without live talent

- Experience with AI voiceover tools (ElevenLabs, Play.ht, or similar)

- Basic motion graphics capability (lower thirds, animated stats, simple explainer sequences)

- Understanding of ad fatigue cycles and how to extend creative lifespan through iteration



## How to Apply



Send the following:



1. A short Loom or video introduction (under 2 minutes) — who you are, what tools you use, and why you're a good fit

2. Three examples of video ads you've edited that ran on Meta or YouTube (links or files — specify which tools/AI you used on each)

3. Your typical turnaround time for a single 30–60s ad creative from brief to final export



No cover letters. No CVs longer than one page. Show us your work instead.

title: AI-First Full-Stack Developer (Next.js)
description:
# AI-First Full-Stack Developer (Next.js) — Moredemand (Remote)



## About Moredemand



Moredemand is an AI-powered SaaS platform for paid advertising analytics, funnel building, and demand generation. We serve agency owners and in-house performance marketers who need to connect ad spend to revenue outcomes without the guesswork.



The platform is in active build across multiple workstreams — ad account analytics, CRM and lead management, page and funnel builder, conversion mapping, and an AI assistant layer (MODA) that ties it all together. This is a ground-floor opportunity to shape a product that sits at the intersection of advertising data, automation, and applied AI.



## The Role



We're hiring a full-stack developer whose default mode is building with AI — not just using it as a novelty feature, but treating it as core infrastructure. You'll be working across the Moredemand platform in Next.js, shipping features end-to-end from spec to production.



This is a hands-on building role. You'll receive detailed specs and PRDs with user stories, business logic, and acceptance criteria (written in Gherkin). You won't be guessing what to build — but you will need to make smart technical decisions about how to build it, and move fast doing so.



You'll be working alongside an existing small dev team and reporting directly to the founder.



## What You'll Be Doing



- Building and shipping production features across the Moredemand platform in Next.js (App Router, Server Components, Server Actions)

- Integrating AI/LLM capabilities throughout the product — not bolted-on chat widgets, but intelligent features woven into the user experience (triage, analysis, recommendations, natural language querying, content generation)

- Working with the Google Ads, Meta Ads, and analytics APIs to ingest, normalise, and surface advertising data

- Building CRM-style interfaces — database views, saved filters, inline actions, dynamic tables, drag-and-drop workflows

- Developing the page/funnel builder module with overlay and popup elements

- Implementing a consent management layer and data-triggered qualification rules

- Writing clean, testable code against Gherkin acceptance criteria provided in each spec

- Using Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent AI-assisted development tooling as a core part of your workflow — not occasionally, but as standard practice

- Shipping iteratively with a bias toward working software over perfect abstractions



## What We're Looking For



- Strong production experience with Next.js 14+ (App Router, not Pages Router) — this is non-negotiable

- Proven ability to build with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, or similar) — prompt engineering, structured outputs, tool use, streaming responses, RAG patterns

- Comfortable across the full stack: React/TypeScript on the front end, Node.js/serverless on the back end, PostgreSQL or equivalent relational database

- Experience integrating third-party APIs — particularly ad platforms, CRMs, or data-heavy SaaS integrations

- Ability to work from a detailed spec and translate user stories and business logic into shipped features without requiring architectural hand-holding

- Familiarity with AI-assisted development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf, or similar) and the discipline to review and own what the tools produce

- Test-driven mindset — you understand Gherkin acceptance criteria and write code that satisfies them

- Clean component architecture, sensible state management, and an instinct for UI that feels fast and responsive

- Self-directed and reliable in a remote, async-first environment — you ship, you communicate, you don't disappear



## Tech Environment



- Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript

- Tailwind CSS

- PostgreSQL

- Anthropic Claude API (primary LLM layer)

- Google Ads API, Meta Marketing API

- Vercel deployment

- Claude Code / AI-assisted development as standard workflow

- Spec-first methodology — block-based architecture, PRDs with Gherkin acceptance criteria, no code or DB schema in specs



## Bonus Points



- Experience building SaaS platforms for marketers or agencies

- Familiarity with advertising data models (campaigns, ad groups, keywords, conversion actions, attribution)

- Experience with real-time dashboards, charting libraries (Recharts, D3), or data visualisation

- Background in building form/page builders or drag-and-drop interfaces

- Understanding of FCA-regulated or compliance-sensitive product environments

- Contributions to open-source or a portfolio of shipped SaaS products



## How to Apply



Send the following:



1. A short Loom (under 3 minutes) walking through a Next.js project you built — show the code, explain the decisions, highlight any AI/LLM integration

2. A brief description of how you currently use AI tooling in your development workflow — what tools, how often, and what you trust them with vs. what you don't

3. One example of a feature you shipped from spec to production, and what the spec looked like vs. what you delivered

4. Your availability (hours per week or full-time) and rate (hourly, daily, or monthly)



No agencies. No CVs padded with frameworks you used once on a tutorial. Show the work.

title: Resident Success Manager
description:
At HomeCrew, we believe people deserve nice rooms for rent in nice areas — and an experience that feels welcoming, thoughtful, and professional from the very beginning.

We are not just helping people find housing. We are creating a resident experience that makes people feel supported, cared for, and confident they made the right choice.

We’re looking for a warm, proactive, highly organized Resident Experience Coordinator to become the welcoming voice of our company. If you love talking with people, creating positive experiences, following through consistently, and making others feel genuinely cared for, this could be a great fit.



About the Role

As our Resident Experience Coordinator, you will be a key point of contact for residents throughout their journey with HomeCrew. You will proactively reach out to residents at important moments — from their initial inquiry to move-in, post-move-in follow-up, quarterly check-ins, and move-out. Your job is to make sure residents feel welcomed, heard, and supported while helping us maintain a high-quality resident experience. This is not just an administrative role. This role directly impacts resident satisfaction, move-in experience, retention, referrals, and the reputation of our brand.



What You’ll Do

• Call new resident inquiries promptly and warmly

• Call residents on the day of move-in

• Call residents the day after move-in

• Call residents a few days after move-in

• Call residents one week after move-in

• Conduct quarterly check-in calls with current residents

• Call residents during the move-out process

• Ask satisfied residents for referrals

• Gather feedback about onboarding, move-in, and overall satisfaction

• Document all conversations clearly and accurately in our systems

• Escalate concerns or issues quickly to the appropriate team member

• Identify recurring feedback or friction points to help improve the resident experience



What Success Looks Like

• Residents feel welcomed, supported, and cared for

• Onboarding and move-in process scores stay high

• Resident satisfaction remains strong

• Follow-up calls are completed consistently and on time

• Issues are identified early before they become larger problems

• Referrals increase from current and outgoing residents

• Communication is clear, professional, and well documented



What We’re Looking For

• Extremely friendly, warm, and professional

• Excellent spoken and written English

• Strong phone presence with the ability to build trust quickly

• Highly organized and detail-oriented

• Reliable and consistent with follow-through

• Calm, empathetic, and a good listener

• Comfortable asking for feedback and referrals

• Tech-savvy and able to keep accurate notes in a CRM or communication system

• Proactive and able to spot problems early

• Committed to high standards, not just checking boxes



Preferred Experience

• Customer service

• Client success

• Hospitality

• Property management

• Tenant communication

• Leasing support

• Virtual assistant or remote support roles



Experience in resident-facing or customer-facing roles is a strong plus.

This Role Is Probably Not a Fit If You

• Dislike talking on the phone

• Sound low-energy, robotic, or disengaged

• Need to be reminded repeatedly to follow up

• Struggle to stay organized

• Do not enjoy building relationships with people

• Prefer task completion over creating a high-quality experience

• See this as “just a VA job” rather than a role that directly impacts reputation, retention, and referrals



Why Join HomeCrew

• Your work will have a direct impact on the resident experience

• You’ll help people feel at home during an important life transition

• You’ll be part of a growing company with clear standards and real purpose

• You’ll have meaningful ownership, not just random tasks

• You’ll help shape the voice and experience of our brand



How to Apply

Please submit the following:

1. Your resume

2. A short written note sharing why you’re a strong fit for this role

3. A 2–3 minute voice recording answering these three questions: 

• Why are you a great fit for a resident-facing, phone-based role?

• How do you make people feel comfortable and cared for quickly?

• How would you ask a happy resident for a referral in a natural, professional way?



Please include the phrase: “People remember how you make them feel” somewhere in your application so we know you read the full post.



We’re looking for someone who genuinely cares about people, communicates with warmth, and takes pride in delivering an exceptional experience.



If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Media Buyer / Paid Ads Manager | Remote | US hours
description:
Media Buyer / Paid Ads Manager

Advanced Digital Automotive Group (ADAG) | Remote | Part-Time to Full-Time | Per-Client Compensation



About ADAG

Advanced Digital Automotive Group (ADAG) is a US-based digital marketing company specializing in SEO and paid advertising for the automotive industry, primarily independent auto repair shops. We manage LSA, Google Ads, and Meta Ads campaigns on behalf of our clients and hold ourselves to one standard: verifiable return on investment for every client, every month.



Role Overview

We are hiring a Media Buyer to own the setup, management, and optimization of Local Services Ads (LSA), Google Ads PPC, and Meta Ads for our client portfolio. The primary focus of this role is LSA. Many of our clients are best served through LSA and we are aggressively expanding this service. PPC and Meta capabilities are required for clients where LSA is not available or not sufficient.

This is a results-driven position. You will not be evaluated on impressions, clicks, or CTR. You will be evaluated on one thing: how much money you made our clients relative to their ad spend (ROAS), verified against their shop management software.



Primary Responsibilities

LSA Management (Priority):

Set up and manage Local Services Ads accounts for auto repair clients. This includes completing the verification process (business registration, insurance, background check coordination), configuring service categories, setting service areas by city or zip code, managing budgets, listening to and disputing invalid leads, and providing monthly optimization recommendations.



PPC Campaign Management:

Plan, build, and manage Google Ads search campaigns for clients where LSA is not available or not the primary channel (e.g. European auto repair, specialty shops). Structure campaigns by service theme (body work, engine repair, transmission, etc.), research and implement transactional keywords, maintain negative keyword lists, and optimize ad copy, landing pages, and Quality Scores on an ongoing basis.



Meta Ads Management:

Build and manage Meta 
/Instagram) ad campaigns for applicable clients. Audience targeting, creative direction, budget management, and performance tracking.



ROAS Reporting:

For each client, provide a monthly report showing ad spend, number of tracked calls/leads, and verified revenue generated. Revenue is verified by matching call tracking numbers (from GHL) against the client's shop management software (Techmetric, Shopware, or equivalent). Reports must show dollar-in, dollar-out. No vanity metrics.



Call Tracking and CRM Integration:

Work within our GoHighLevel (GHL) setup. Understand call tracking, lead attribution, and how to connect ad performance data back to client revenue. When clients provide access to their shop management software, leverage it for full revenue attribution.



Review and Ranking Optimization (LSA-specific):

Advise clients on strategies to improve their LSA ranking position, primarily through Google review acquisition, Google Business Profile optimization, and response time improvement.



Requirements

    1. Minimum 3 years experience managing Google Ads campaigns for local service businesses.

    2. Demonstrable LSA experience: account setup including verification, budget management, call dispute process, and service area configuration.

    3. Experience with Google Ads conversion tracking setup via Google Tag Manager.

    4. Working knowledge of Meta Ads campaign management.

    5. Familiarity with call tracking tools and CRM-based lead attribution (GHL preferred).

    6. Proficiency using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent) as part of daily workflow for campaign analysis, keyword research, and reporting.

    7. Ability to manage 8 to 10 ad accounts simultaneously without performance degradation.

    8. Strong understanding of ROAS calculation and the ability to tie ad spend to verified client revenue.

    9. Clear, professional written communication in English.



Nice to Have

    10. Google Ads certification.

    11. Experience with automotive industry clients (auto repair, dealerships, specialty shops).

    12. Experience with Techmetric, Shopware, or other automotive shop management software.

    13. Familiarity with SEMrush, Microsoft Clarity, or similar analysis tools.

    14. Experience using Meta MCP or similar tools to connect ad accounts to AI workflows.



Compensation

This role is compensated on a per-client basis. We do not pay hourly rates or flat monthly salaries.

When applying, you must provide your proposed rate in USD per client per month. Your rate should reflect the full scope of managing one client account, including LSA monitoring, any PPC or Meta management required, monthly reporting, and all optimization activities. Rates that do not specify a per-client USD monthly figure will not be considered.

As our client portfolio grows, your earnings grow with it. At full capacity (8 to 10 accounts) the expectation is a full-time workload and compensation to match.



What Success Looks Like

At the end of each month, you can tell us exactly how much money each client spent on ads and exactly how much verified revenue came back through the door. You flag underperforming accounts before clients do. You manage your account load without being chased for updates. You treat client ad budgets like your own money.

title: Senior SEO Link Audit & Negative SEO Protection Specialist
description:

About The Role



We are seeking a highly experienced SEO professional to take immediate ownership of backlink auditing, toxic link identification, disavow management, and ongoing negative SEO protection for a growing portfolio of websites.



This is not a general SEO position.



We are specifically looking for someone who has extensive experience identifying harmful backlink patterns, managing disavow files, responding to negative SEO attacks, and protecting organic rankings from malicious or low-quality link activity.



The successful candidate will be expected to commence immediately and proactively monitor backlink profiles on an ongoing basis.



Key Responsibilities

Immediate Priority Tasks

Conduct a comprehensive backlink audit across assigned websites.

Analyse all referring domains and backlinks using industry-leading tools.

Identify:

Toxic backlinks

Spam links

PBN links

Link farm networks

Foreign-language spam

Hacked website links

Sitewide spam links

Automated directory submissions

Redirect spam

Parasite SEO links

Exact-match anchor text manipulation

Any other suspicious or unnatural link patterns

Prepare and maintain Google-compliant disavow files.

Deliver a complete risk assessment of each backlink profile.

Provide recommendations for protecting rankings and reducing future risk.

Ongoing Responsibilities

Weekly Backlink Monitoring

Review backlink profiles weekly.

Monitor for new referring domains and unusual link acquisition activity.

Detect and investigate suspicious backlink spikes.

Identify emerging toxic links before they impact rankings.

Maintain and update disavow files as required.

Monitor anchor text distribution and link velocity trends.

Escalate any signs of negative SEO activity immediately.

Negative SEO Protection

Proactively monitor websites for:

Toxic link attacks

Competitor sabotage

Automated spam campaigns

Link injection attacks

Redirect spam campaigns

Large-scale foreign-language spam attacks

Manipulative anchor text campaigns

Recommend and implement preventative measures where required.

Required Skills & Experience

Essential

Minimum 5 years SEO experience.

Proven experience conducting large-scale backlink audits.

Extensive knowledge of:

Google Search Console

Ahrefs

SEMrush

Majestic

Google Link Spam Policies

Penguin-related ranking impacts

Strong understanding of Google's current stance on link quality and disavow management.

Ability to manually assess backlinks rather than relying solely on automated toxicity scores.

Excellent analytical and investigative skills.

Strong attention to detail.

Highly Desirable

Experience handling active negative SEO attacks.

Experience recovering websites affected by harmful backlink profiles.

Agency experience.

Experience auditing websites with thousands of referring domains.

Understanding of local SEO and national SEO campaigns.

Deliverables

Initial Deliverables

Full backlink audit.

Toxic link assessment.

Referring domain analysis.

Recommended disavow file.

Risk report outlining immediate concerns.

Action plan for ongoing monitoring.

Ongoing Deliverables

Weekly backlink monitoring reports.

Updated disavow recommendations.

Monthly backlink health reports.

Immediate notifications when suspicious activity is detected.

Ongoing recommendations to improve backlink profile quality and resilience.

Application Requirements



Please provide:



Years of SEO experience.

Examples of backlink audits completed.

Examples of websites recovered from toxic backlink issues.

Experience dealing with negative SEO attacks.

Tools used for backlink analysis.

Availability to commence.

Hourly rate or fixed monthly fee.

Important



We are currently experiencing what appears to be an ongoing negative SEO attack and require a specialist who can begin immediately.



This role is focused on backlink auditing, toxic link management, disavow strategy, and ongoing protection of organic rankings.



We are looking for a genuine expert with proven experience in identifying and mitigating harmful backlink activity—not a general SEO practitioner.



Priority will be given to applicants who can start within 24 hours and demonstrate previous experience managing negative SEO threats and backlink recovery projects.

title: Marketing Team Member — Digital, Social, and Content (4 Roles)
description:
Read This First

We are not looking for someone to "manage social media." We are looking for four sharp marketers who can execute across a portfolio of real, revenue-generating companies in mental health, medical tourism, equine-assisted therapy, and wellness. If you need hand-holding, this is not your job. If you want to own your work and grow with us, keep reading.



What You Will Actually Do

You will execute digital marketing, social media, faceless YouTube content, and brand design across multiple companies. You will plan content, ship it, measure it, and improve it. You will not just post. You will help build audiences and pipelines.



Who You Are

You have run social accounts that have grown. You have worked on a YouTube channel and can prove it. You design clean assets in Canva or Adobe without supervision. You edit a video that holds attention. You understand SEO, paid ads on Google and Meta, and you read analytics like a native language. You handle multiple brands without dropping the ball, and you make decisions based on data, not vibes.



Non-Negotiables

You work the graveyard shift. You have a quiet home office, fast and stable internet, your own computer, and noise-cancelling headphones. You are available immediately for full-time work. You are comfortable with the pay range above.



What You Get

Remote work. A long-term seat on a team building across industries. Real exposure to multi-brand marketing and YouTube growth at scale. Room to grow for the right people.



How to Stand Out

The candidates who have wowed us in the past did more than answer questions. They sold themselves like they sell brands. If you want to get our attention, send us:



- A portfolio link with real work you actually shipped (channels, accounts, ad campaigns, design samples, edited videos).

- A short marketing video pitching yourself the same way you would pitch a client. Show us your hook, your editing, your personality.

- Screenshots or case studies with real numbers. Followers grown, views earned, leads generated, ad spend managed, ROAS, watch time. Vanity metrics without context will not impress us.

- A mock content idea, thumbnail, or 30-second concept for one of our industries (mental health, medical tourism, equine therapy, or wellness). You do not need to be perfect. You need to show you can think.



If you skip this section, you can still apply. But the people who do this are the ones who get hired.



How to Apply (Read Carefully)

Applications without an audio file will be ignored. No exceptions.



Record an audio application, upload it to Google Drive, and include the link in your written application. In the audio, answer all of the following:



Your digital marketing and social media experience, with specifics and numbers.

YouTube channels you have worked on, your role, and what happened to the channel.

Your design and video editing tools, and your comfort level with each.

Your SEO and paid ads experience, with platforms and results.

How you handle work across multiple brands without things slipping.

A time you used data to change a marketing decision.

Any admin or virtual assistant experience.

Cold calling or outbound experience.

Confirmation you can work the graveyard shift.

Your home situation and any responsibilities that affect your work.

Your office setup, internet speed, computer, and headphones.

Distractions in your home (children, pets, family).

Whether you can start immediately full-time.

Whether the ?20,000–?35,000/month range works for you.



If your audio is vague, generic, or sounds like every other application, we will pass. Be specific. Be honest. Show us how you think.

title: LinkedIn Content & AI Tools VA for Career Coach and Keynote Speaker
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

A U.S.-based career coach and keynote speaker is looking for a Virtual Assistant who lives in the details of social media and knows how to take half-finished content and make it land.

This is not a general VA role. The primary job is LinkedIn content management: scheduling posts, closing the last 30% of drafts, keeping a consistent publishing cadence, and making everything look polished before it goes live. Everything else — resume reformatting, Asana management, B2B outreach support — layers on top of that core skill.

If you have never actually managed social media for a coach, consultant, or personal brand, this role is not a good fit. If you have, keep reading.

Pave Talent is hiring on behalf of our client, a one-person career coaching and speaking practice based in the U.S. with a growing pipeline of corporate and B2B clients.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Content and LinkedIn Management (primary, ~50% of your time)



Manage the LinkedIn content calendar and keep posting consistent week over week

Take 70%-complete drafts and get them publish-ready: close gaps, fix formatting, ensure visual quality

Schedule and publish content on LinkedIn and other platforms

Monitor engagement and flag anything that needs attention



Resume and Career Documents



Reformat resumes in Microsoft Word using custom AI prompts (Claude preferred)

Convert resumes into LinkedIn summaries, cover letters, and other career documents

Refine AI-generated output so it sounds human, not generated



Speaking and Event Operations



Process post-event survey responses and send segmented outreach by response type

Conduct LinkedIn outreach to event attendees using provided templates

Track pre- and post-event logistics in Asana



Business Development Support



Support B2B outreach to wealth management firms and companies going through layoffs

Help maintain outreach sequences and track pipeline activity



Operations and Reporting



Manage Asana daily: update task statuses, flag what needs attention, keep dashboards current

Send daily and weekly activity reports





WHO THIS IS FOR

You have managed LinkedIn or social media for a coach, consultant, speaker, or personal brand before. Not just scheduled posts but owned the cadence, caught the gaps, and kept things moving without being chased.

You know how to use AI tools (Claude specifically) and you know the difference between raw generated output and something that is actually ready to publish. You fix the output. You do not just paste it.

You finish things. When something is stuck, you say so before it becomes a problem.

You have reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup. Connectivity issues are a dealbreaker for this role.



REQUIRED



Demonstrated experience managing LinkedIn or social media for a coach, consultant, or personal brand

Proficiency with Claude or similar AI tools, with the judgment to refine output

Asana or equivalent project management experience

Professional written English

Microsoft Word and Google Suite proficiency

Reliable high-speed internet and dedicated home office



BONUS



Background in career coaching, staffing, or HR

B2B outreach or lead generation experience

Experience with content scheduling tools





COMPENSATION AND SCHEDULE



Rate: $8 to $10 USD per hour

Hours: 20 hours per week to start, path to 40 hours based on performance

Schedule: Flexible async with 2 to 3 hours daily overlap at 2:00 PM Pacific (5:00 AM Philippine Time)

Contract, remote, Philippines-based

Start: ASAP





TO APPLY

In your application, tell us about a specific social media account you managed for a coach, consultant, or personal brand. What did you do, how often did you post, and what did you learn about keeping content consistent?

Applications without a direct answer to this question will not be reviewed.

title: Shopify Product Page & CRO Specialist Wanted (Part-time | Long-term)

Our store focuses on Home, Garden & Household products. We test multiple new products every day, 5 days per week. Therefore, we need someone who can move fast and continuously improve and optimize product pages.



We use PagePilot to generate product pages. Your role is to further optimize these pages, make them more professional, and improve them for maximum conversion.



This is not a full-time position. The average workload is around 2 hours per day. However, we are looking for a long-term collaboration. As the business grows, there will be opportunities for more hours and responsibilities.



Responsibilities

Optimize Shopify product pages for higher conversion rates.

Improve product descriptions, USPs, layouts, and trust elements.

Set up and optimize product bundles using the Kaching Bundle App.

Think along about CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization) and suggest improvements.

Ensure a professional and consistent look across the store.



Requirements

Proven experience with Shopify.

Experience optimizing product pages.

Strong understanding of CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization).

Experience with Shopify apps and product bundling.

Strong sense of design and product presentation.

Ability to work independently and take initiative.

Good command of English.

Basic knowledge of Dutch is a plus, but not required. Product pages are written in Dutch, but AI/translation tools may be used to understand and optimize them.



What we offer

Long-term collaboration.

Flexible working hours.

Weekly payments.

Hourly-based compensation.

Access to paid tools such as Higgsfield AI.

A growing e-commerce business with continuous work.



Application

Links to 2–3 Shopify product pages you have personally optimized.

A short explanation of what improvements you made and why.

Your hourly rate.

Your weekly availability.

A short description of your experience with Shopify, CRO, and product bundling.
